title: Experienced Cold Calling Appointment Setter (Part Time, US Hours) for a Commercial Cleaning Company
description:
Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company serving Fairfield County, Connecticut and Westchester County, New York (
). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at the offices we serve and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator, managing partner or owner.



Your standard is 150 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a business: its customers, its staff and its reputation.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Thursday, 5 hours a day. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is currently 11 PM to 1 AM and 2 AM to 5 AM, and it shifts by one hour when US clocks change in March. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$10 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

You must have worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company: commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services. At least 3 years of outbound cold calling appointment setting, and at least part of it for a cleaning company, booking appointments with US businesses. If you have not worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company, do not apply.

You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.

A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear, neutral spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call, with no heavy accent and no strong regional pronunciation.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.



HOW TO APPLY

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, $5 to $7 per hour, [your name]. We do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to offices near you. Are you the person who d
 on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. We listen for clear, neutral English and a natural tone. Make sure the link opens without a login.

2. Your cleaning company experience: the company name, your role, how long you worked there, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Then your total years of cold calling appointment setting.

3. The CRMs you have used.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week?



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed. Finalists do a 10 minute live role-play call with Johan.



Applications close Wednesday, November 18 at 11:59 PM Philippine time. We reply only to finalists, by Friday, November 20.



Johan Montenegro, Keeper Facility Care

title: Junior Video Editor | Social Media & Personal Brand
description:
We're looking for a creative Junior Video Editor who knows how to make content people actually want to watch.



You'll work closely with our Senior Video Editor and Founder, creating short-form content for our marketing agency and the Founder's personal brand.



This includes educational Reels, podcast clips, lifestyle content and creative edits that stand out on social media.



We're a growing marketing agency that values creativity, speed and quality. We use AI tools to make editing faster and more efficient, so you can focus on producing great content.



This role is perfect for someone who loves video editing, understands social media trends and wants to grow their skills in a fast-moving creative team.



IMPORTANT: You must use Adobe Premiere Pro.



What You'll Be Doing



1. Short-Form Social Media Content (Main Focus)

- Edit engaging Instagram Reels for our agency and Founder's personal brand.

- Create a mix of educational, podcast, lifestyle and trend-driven content.

- Add captions, motion graphics, B-roll, music and sound effects to bring videos to life.

- Use creative storytelling, strong hooks and pacing to keep viewers watching.

- Stay on top of social media trends and bring fresh editing ideas to the team.



2. Podcast & Video Content

- Turn long-form podcasts into engaging short-form clips.

- Occasionally edit full podcast episodes, including audio clean-up.

- Edit internal training videos and Video Sales Letters (VSLs).



3. AI-Assisted Editing

- Use AI tools to speed up editing, clipping, captions and other repetitive tasks.

- Find ways to improve workflows without sacrificing quality.

- Help us increase content output while maintaining a high standard.



Who We're Looking For

- 1–3 years of editing experience, including freelance or strong portfolio work.

- Confident in Adobe Premiere Pro (required). After Effects experience is highly regarded.

- Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, short-form storytelling and what makes people stop scrolling.

- A creative eye for pacing, sound design, motion graphics and visual storytelling.

- Comfortable editing both professional educational content and fun, creative lifestyle videos.

- Familiar with AI editing tools or eager to learn how to use them.

- Organised, reliable and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Open to feedback, quick with revisions and always looking to improve.

- Proactive, creative and genuinely interested in social media and internet culture.



We're not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want an editor who can take raw footage, spot the best moments and turn them into content worth watching.



What We Offer

- Direct mentorship from an experienced Senior Video Editor.

- Opportunity to work closely with the Founder and help grow his personal brand.

- A young, ambitious and creative team that enjoys what we do.

- Exposure to social media, paid advertising, podcasting and personal brand content.

- Opportunities to develop your skills and grow with the agency.

- Pay based on experience and availability.



How To Apply - No cover letters. Just send us these two things:



1. Your Portfolio - Share links to your best editing work, ideally short-form Reels, podcast clips, personal brand or lifestyle content.



2. A 1–2 Minute Loom Video (MUST) - Introduce yourself and briefly answer:

title: Remote AI Automation Specialist
description:
⚠️ LOOM VIDEO REQUIRED: Show us one automation project you built. We will not review any application that comes in without a Loom link. Details are in the "How to Apply" section below.

-----

Are you the person who can't leave a repetitive task alone until you've automated it? We're a growing U.S.-based insurance district, and we're hiring an AI Workflow Automation Specialist to build smart, AI-powered systems that give our leadership team hours back every week, while also handling the everyday admin that keeps our office on track.



This is a non-sales, builder-first role for someone whose AI skills go far past asking a chatbot questions. You'll get to know how our team works, find the tasks that eat up the most time, and replace them with reliable solutions built on Claude, Google Workspace, and our meeting and tracking tools. Some days you'll be designing workflows; other days you'll be keeping the operation running. If you like both, you'll fit right in.



Your Day to Day

- Map out our team's daily routines and identify the manual, repeat work that AI can handle instead

- Build and maintain Claude Projects, Skills, and prompt templates for recurring outputs like
 drafts, SOPs, reports, and summaries

- Turn Read.ai meeting recordings and transcripts into clean recaps, action items, and follow-ups

- Clean up, streamline, and automate our Google Sheets trackers and reports so they update with minimal manual work

- Keep our AI toolkit organized: document what you build so anyone on the team can use it, and help teammates get comfortable with it

- Handle general admin tasks such as writing
s, organizing shared drive folders, entering data, and keeping our online listings and Google reviews up to date

- Take on daily requests as they arrive and spot what needs doing before anyone asks



What You Bring

- 2 to 3 years of virtual assistant experience, including at least 1 year building AI-powered workflows for a business (using AI now and then to help write doesn't qualify)

- Strong prompt engineering: you write structured, multi-step prompts with clear instructions, examples, and output formats, and you test and refine them until they deliver consistent results

- A track record of building reusable AI tools a team depends on, such as Claude Projects or Skills, custom GPTs, or something similar

- Hands-on experience connecting AI to business tools using Zapier, Make, n8n, or Google Apps Script; experience with APIs or MCP integrations is a major plus

- Advanced Google Sheets skills, including QUERY, XLOOKUP, and IMPORTRANGE, with a habit of keeping data clean and organized

- Sound judgment about AI's strengths and limits; you double-check outputs for accuracy and handle confidential information responsibly

- Curiosity about new AI tools and features, and the ability to explain them simply to teammates who aren't technical

- Excellent written and spoken English; organized, self-driven, and discreet

- Background in insurance, financial services, or any fast-paced, operations-heavy business is a plus.



You'll Thrive Here If You

- Get a kick out of finding faster, smarter ways to work

- Like to understand a problem fully before you start building

- Enjoy mixing technical projects with steady, behind-the-scenes admin support

- Are looking for a stable, long-term home with a growing team instead of short-term projects



How to Apply

- REQUIRED: A Loom video (3 to 5 minutes) walking us through one sample automation project you built. Share your screen and show us the actual automation, then cover:

- The problem or task it was built to solve

- The tools you used (for example Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier, Make, n8n, or Apps Script) and how they connect

- The automation running, or a screen walkthrough of how it works step by step

- The result: what it replaced and how much time or effort it saves

- Place your Loom link at the very top of your application. Applications without a Loom video of a sample automation project will not be considered.



Along with your Loom video, please send:

- A short summary of your virtual assistant background and the AI tools you use most

- A brief answer to this question: "Describe a task you automated with AI. What did it replace, and how much time does it save?"

- A link to your latest CV or resume

- Confirmation that you can work full-time during Mountain Time business hours

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 100,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Global Strategies is seeking a highly skilled Senior Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting needs of a diverse portfolio of U.S.-based clients, including nonprofit organizations, government contractors, construction companies, and service-based businesses.



This is a hands-on, technically focused role for an experienced CPA with deep knowledge of U.S. accounting practices and strong accounting judgment. The ideal candidate can independently work through complex accounting issues, identify problems before they become larger issues, and consistently produce accurate, high-quality work with minimal supervision.



This position works primarily behind the scenes alongside Client Accounting Managers and other accounting staff to ensure client books are accurate, complete, and closed on time. We are also looking for someone who is comfortable with accounting technology and can take ownership of improving how the firm uses certain systems, tools, and workflows. This is not a technology role, but strong systems aptitude and a willingness to learn, optimize, and improve processes are important.



Responsibilities



- Perform monthly accounting and close activities for assigned clients.

- Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial statements.

- Analyze general ledger activity and financial statements to identify errors, inconsistencies, unusual activity, and necessary adjustments.

- Independently research, troubleshoot, and resolve complex or unfamiliar accounting issues using sound accounting judgment.

- Maintain and reconcile accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, payroll liabilities, and other balance sheet accounts.

- Perform complex account cleanups and resolve historical accounting issues.

- Review accounting work completed by other team members when needed and provide technical guidance and support.

- Assist with payroll accounting and other back-office accounting functions based on individual client needs.

- Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for annual audits and respond to auditor requests.

- Work across different accounting systems, client processes, and reporting requirements.

- Coordinate with Client Accounting Managers to ensure financials are accurate and ready for client delivery by established deadlines.

- Communicate with clients as needed to obtain information or resolve accounting matters.

- Become highly proficient in firm-utilized accounting and workflow systems and help ensure those systems are being used effectively.

- Take ownership of evaluating and improving certain internal workflows, system configurations, and processes where opportunities for better efficiency, consistency, or automation exist.

- Help identify practical technology and process improvements that can make the accounting team more efficient without disrupting client service.



Qualifications



- Active CPA license required.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.

- 7+ years of progressive professional accounting experience required.

- Significant hands-on experience performing accounting for U.S.-based companies required.

- Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, general ledger accounting, accrual accounting, month-end close, financial statement preparation, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Demonstrated ability to independently identify, research, and resolve complex accounting problems.

- Strong understanding of debits and credits with the ability to apply accounting principles to new and unfamiliar situations.

- Strong financial statement analysis skills and ability to recognize when balances, transactions, or financial results do not make sense.

- Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

- Ability to manage accounting responsibilities across multiple clients and meet established deadlines.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong comfort with technology, accounting software, and learning new systems.

- Ability to understand how accounting and workflow systems are configured and identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and automation.

- Ability and willingness to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

- U.S. CPA license highly preferred, but not required.

- Experience with nonprofit accounting, government contractors, construction, public accounting, or audit is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means producing highly accurate accounting work, independently solving technical accounting problems, identifying issues before they require escalation, consistently meeting close deadlines, and becoming a trusted technical accounting resource for the team.



Success also means becoming someone the team can rely on to understand the systems we use, recognize where processes can be improved, and take ownership of implementing practical improvements that make the firm more efficient and scalable.

title: 2D Animator & Video Editor for YouTube (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
About the Project



We are launching a new English-language YouTube channel focused on finance, economics, business stories, and historical events.



We are looking for a creative and reliable 2D Animator / Video Editor who can turn our scripts and voice-overs into engaging, entertaining animated YouTube videos.



The animation style should be simple, playful, cartoon-like, and easy to understand, similar to the YouTube channel Crayon Capital.



We are looking to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.



Animation Style — IMPORTANT



We are looking for simple, childlike 2D animations that make complicated topics entertaining and easy to understand.



Please watch the first 30–60 seconds of these videos to understand the style we want:



Example 1 — Crayon Capital:





Example 2 — Crayon Capital:





Example 3 — Crayon Capital:





The animations should include:



Simple, expressive cartoon characters



Funny facial expressions and character movements



Clean, colorful 2D illustrations



Smooth but relatively simple animations



Visual storytelling that matches the voice-over



Creative explanations using characters, objects, charts, and symbols



Frequent visual changes to keep viewers engaged



A consistent and recognizable animation style



Important: These videos are references for the level of simplicity, storytelling, and animation quality. We want to develop our own original characters and visual identity, not copy another channel's artwork.



What We Will Provide



You will receive:



A complete English script



The finished English voice-over



The video topic and creative direction



Reference videos for the animation style



The YouTube thumbnail



You do NOT need to write scripts, record voice-overs, create thumbnails, or manage the YouTube channel.



Your Responsibilities



Your job will be to:



Create original 2D cartoon illustrations and animations based on the script.



Synchronize all animations with the provided voice-over.



Turn the narration into an entertaining visual story.



Create a complete, professionally edited YouTube video.



Maintain consistent characters, colors, and visual quality.



Deliver the finished video in 1080p (16:9).



Make reasonable revisions based on feedback.



Videos will typically be 10–15 minutes long.



We prefer creative storytelling and engaging animations over unnecessarily complicated animation techniques.



Requirements



Experience creating 2D animations or animated explainer videos



Strong video editing skills



Ability to create or adapt cartoon characters and illustrations



Experience with After Effects, Adobe Animate, Moho, Toon Boom, or similar software



Ability to synchronize animations accurately with voice-overs



Good English comprehension



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Ability to deliver original work suitable for commercial YouTube use



AI-assisted tools are welcome when used responsibly, but the final animation must be visually consistent, polished, and engaging. Basic AI slideshows or static images with zoom effects are not what we are looking for.



Long-Term Opportunity



We plan to start with a small number of videos and increase production as the channel grows.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming our regular animator and growing with the channel.



Successful collaboration may lead to consistent monthly projects.



How to Apply



Please include the following information:



1. Portfolio



Send links to 2–3 animated videos you have personally worked on. Examples similar to our references are strongly preferred.



2. Price



What would you charge to fully animate and edit one 10–15 minute YouTube video if we provide the complete script and voice-over?



3. Turnaround Time



How many days would you need to complete one 10–15 minute video?



4. Software



Which animation and editing software do you use?



5. Experience



Have you created animated YouTube documentaries, educational videos, or explainer videos before?



Selection Process



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid 20–30 second animation test using a script and voice-over we provide.



This will allow us to evaluate your animation style, creativity, communication, and ability to follow instructions before starting a full-length project.



We are looking for the best combination of quality, creativity, reliability, and reasonable pricing.



If you believe you can create animations similar in quality and storytelling style to our reference videos, we would love to see your work!



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer (AI-Assisted Production)
description:
WebDone is a UK website and marketing agency working with small businesses. We’re building a more productive creative team by combining our designer’s assets, client footage, motion graphics and AI-assisted video. We’re looking for a video editor who is, above all, a strong visual storyteller.



The role: A part-time, ongoing opportunity for someone who can take a brief, make strong creative decisions and deliver polished, publish-ready content reliably. You’ll turn footage, copy, brand templates and our designer’s assets into engaging reels, short videos and paid social ads, using a mix of traditional editing, motion graphics and AI video tools.



Your responsibilities:



Edit short-form videos (reels, short videos and paid social ads) for Instagram,
, TikTok and other platforms, telling a clear, well-structured story.

Animate static designs, logos and layered assets supplied by our designer.

Create kinetic typography, animated headlines and transitions.

Animate website mockups, scrolling websites and before-and-after comparisons.

Produce subtle logo animations, including looping GIFs.

Use AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar) alongside traditional editing and motion graphics.

Add accurate captions, text overlays, music and sound treatment, and export correctly for Reels, Stories and Feed.

Work from Figma, SVG or layered design files and supply editable project files.

Keep files organised and flag missing materials or deadline risks early.



What we’re looking for:



Strong storytelling and creative judgement, the ability to turn footage and assets into a complete, well-told piece, not just well-edited clips.

A strong portfolio of short-form video editing and motion graphics.

Confident use of After Effects (or equivalent) and an editing tool such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

Experience with, or willingness to learn, AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Seedance). We won’t exclude a strong editor for not having used a specific platform, and we provide a paid Higgsfield subscription.

Ability to animate a designer’s supplied assets into polished, professional motion (not advanced 3D).

Ability to work independently from a brief without needing constant creative direction.

Strong written English, attention to detail and reliable communication.

Ability to follow different client brands without making every video look the same.



Hours and pay:



Initially around 10 hours per week, with potential to grow.

$8 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability to deliver finished, publish-ready content.

Rate agreed before any paid work begins. Flexible hours, with agreed availability for UK-team communication.



Our hiring process:



Application and portfolio review.

A short paid task for shortlisted applicants (brief, payment and deadline agreed beforehand).

We intend to offer one candidate the ongoing position.



How to apply: Use the subject line “WebDone Video + Motion + AI” and include:



Two or three short-form video examples. Explain exactly which parts you created, and what story you were telling.

Two or three examples of motion graphics or animation you personally created.

If you’ve used any AI video tools, tell us which and share an example.

Your editing, motion and AI software, and your experience with Figma or layered design files.

Your requested hourly rate within the advertised range.

Your weekly availability, time zone and earliest start date.

A brief example of how you handled an unclear brief or missing assets, working independently.



Please share direct links we can open without requesting access. A small, relevant selection is more useful than a large portfolio.

# Shopify Developer & eCommerce Virtual Assistant



**Company:** Vexnova  

**Position:** Part-Time, Remote  

**Type:** Contract / Virtual Assistant  

**Compensation:** Based on experience  

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during U.S. Eastern business hours



## About Vexnova



Vexnova is a digital commerce operating partner helping businesses modernize how they operate and grow.



We work with companies to improve their digital commerce capabilities through eCommerce strategy, website development, conversion optimization, technology integrations, and operational improvements.



We are looking for an experienced **Shopify Developer & eCommerce Virtual Assistant** to support the development, management, and optimization of Shopify websites for our growing portfolio of clients.



This is a hands-on position for someone who understands both Shopify development and the fundamentals of creating an effective eCommerce customer experience.



## Key Responsibilities



**Shopify Website Development**

- Build, customize, and maintain Shopify websites.

- Modify Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Develop and improve product pages, collection pages, navigation, and landing pages.

- Ensure responsive, mobile-friendly website experiences.

- Troubleshoot technical issues, bugs, and theme conflicts.

- Support new Shopify store setups, configurations, and launches.



**eCommerce Optimization**

- Implement website improvements designed to increase conversion rates.

- Optimize product detail pages, navigation, search, and merchandising experiences.

- Improve website speed, usability, and overall performance.

- Configure and integrate Shopify apps and third-party solutions.

- Assist with checkout, payment, shipping, and financing integrations.

- Implement promotional features, product bundles, and upsell opportunities.



**Website Operations & Support**

- Manage product uploads, collections, and merchandising updates.

- Assist with ongoing website maintenance and updates.

- Test new features before deployment.

- Identify technical issues and recommend improvements.

- Document completed work and provide regular progress updates.

- Work collaboratively with Vexnova leadership and other team members.



## Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience.

- Strong understanding of Shopify themes, Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience building or significantly customizing Shopify websites.

- Familiarity with Shopify apps, integrations, and store configurations.

- Understanding of eCommerce UX, mobile optimization, and conversion best practices.

- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues independently.

- Strong attention to detail and quality assurance.

- Good written English and ability to communicate progress clearly.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience launching new Shopify stores from the ground up.

- Experience with Shopify 2.0 themes and custom sections.

- Experience integrating subscription, financing, installation, or service-booking solutions.

- Familiarity with Shopify Search & Discovery, product filtering, and merchandising.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

- Familiarity with technical SEO and website performance optimization.

- Experience working with U.S.-based eCommerce brands.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who can do more than follow basic instructions.



The right candidate understands how an eCommerce website should function, can recommend better approaches when appropriate, and takes ownership of delivering high-quality work.



You should be comfortable receiving business requirements, translating them into technical solutions, and implementing those solutions with minimal supervision.



This is an opportunity to support multiple eCommerce brands and potentially grow into a larger technical role as Vexnova expands.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction outlining your Shopify development experience.

2. Links to 3 Shopify websites you have personally developed or significantly customized. Explain your specific contributions.

3. Your experience with Shopify Liquid, custom theme development, and third-party integrations.

4. An example of a challenging Shopify problem you solved.

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

6. Any experience using AI tools to accelerate Shopify development.



**Please include "Shopify Vexnova" in the subject line of your application.**



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate actual development work, not just basic product management or page-building experience.

title: SENIOR NEXT.JS DEVELOPER | REAL ESTATE PLATFORM + SECURE INVESTOR PORTAL
description:
BUILD SOMETHING REAL

We're building One Koncept's central digital platform: a premium construction and development website, searchable homes and rental listings, and a private investor experience. We need a developer who has shipped secure production applications—not just attractive landing pages.



YOUR MISSION

• Launch a polished, mobile-first public site featuring One Koncept Build, portfolios, lead forms and CMS-managed pages.

• Build searchable property listings with maps, filters, photos, status and inquiry workflows.

• Deliver an authenticated investor dashboard with robust server-side permissions and secure document access.

• Evaluate Terra Notes API/SSO/deep-link options and implement the approved feasible integration or secure handoff.

• Own testing, performance, accessibility, documentation, deployment and handover with Shahjehan, our technical lead.



YOU MUST HAVE

• Live production Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript work you personally built.

• Headless CMS delivery (Payload preferred; Sanity, Strapi or Contentful welcome).

• Proven secure client portals, dashboards or multi-tenant apps with user-specific access control.

• Ability to explain backend authorization: how do you prevent one investor from viewing another's documents by changing a URL?

• Experience with interactive listings/maps and filtering (Mapbox, Google Maps or similar).

• At least 3–4 hours daily overlap with Arizona and clear communication.



THE DELIVERY PLAN

Proposed public-site launch by Day 7; listings and booking in Weeks 2–3; secure portal in Weeks 3–4; QA and handover by Weeks 5–6. These are planning targets contingent on approved staffing, dependencies and scope. Security verification is required before portal launch.



APPLY

Send 3–5 live examples (including a secure portal), your personal role in each, USD hourly rate, weekly availability, Arizona overlap, earliest start date, stack/security proposal, estimated hours by workstream, and relevant references.



MANDATORY 2–3 MINUTE VIDEO

Introduce yourself; describe a live Next.js/TypeScript project with authenticated users that you personally built; explain your role and how you enforce investor-specific access on the server; and tell us why you're a fit for listings/maps and an investor portal. Share a viewable Loom, Google Drive or unlisted video link. Applications without the video and relevant live examples will not advance.

Troubleshoot day-to-day HubSpot issues.

WHAT MATTERS MOST TO US



Skills can be taught. Character can’t. Above everything else, we’re looking for someone we can fully rely on.



> Trust: You’ll have access to customer data, payment systems, and sensitive business information. We need someone who handles that responsibility with care and discretion.



> Integrity: You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest about mistakes, transparent in your work, and never cut corners on processes or compliance.



> Accountability: You own your tasks from start to finish. When something goes wrong, you take responsibility, fix it, and learn from it instead of making excuses.



If these values describe you, you’ll fit right in.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Customer Communication: Reply to customer
s and live chats using macro templates, handle occasional inbound and outbound calls, and write warm, professional responses for complex cases.



2. Order Management: Keep orders moving by updating order details, shipping information, tracking, and status changes accurately.



3. Financial Accuracy: Process refunds, resends, and credit adjustments, and reconcile transactions across our payment processors.



4. Problem Solving: Resolve customer concerns quickly by following our Customer Service SOP and working closely with management and fulfillment.

9. Project & Task Management: Handle multiple ongoing projects using task management tools, meet deadlines, and keep stakeholders updated.

REQUIREMENTS



Experience & Skills

~ Strong time management and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines consistently



Character & Work Style



~ Trustworthy, honest, and discreet with confidential information

~ Takes full ownership and accountability for results

~ Sharp attention to detail; catches errors before they become problems

~ Follows instructions and SOPs precisely and consistently

~ Thinks critically and proposes smart solutions independently

~ Asks questions when unsure instead of making assumptions

~ Works independently with minimal supervision, while collaborating well with the team



Workspace



~ Quiet workspace and headset for occasional calls

~ Reliable internet connection

~ Available to work flexible hours, including weekends

~ Comfortable using multiple systems, platforms, and browser-based tools



Nice to Have



~ Experience with Instagram and TikTok content posting and engagement

~ Experience with Canva or AI tools for graphics and promotional materials

~ Familiarity with or genuine interest in the peptide and wellness industry



A Note on Commitment



We want serious applicants only. We’re not considering anyone who is moonlighting or currently holding other jobs. We respect everyone’s hustle, but we’re hiring someone who will give this role their full focus.



WHAT WE OFFER



Competitive monthly salary based on experience and skills

Flexible remote work from your own space

Long-term, stable role with real growth opportunities

A supportive team that values your input and initiative

title: Operations/Process Excellence Manager (Remote, Philippines-based)
description:
Operations/Process Excellence Manager (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA Home Care is a licensed home care agency in Atlanta, Georgia, and part of a small group of healthcare companies I founded and own. Our caregivers serve clients in their homes every day. Our scheduling and coordination team works remotely from the Philippines, and senior operations managers watch that team live through the US day.



We are direct and clear about everything we do. We are in healthcare, and trust matters more than anything else.



I am hiring someone to build the processes and procedures that team runs on. Our Director of Operations fights the fires. You will work beside him and build the system that keeps them from starting.



YOU DO NOT NEED HOME CARE EXPERIENCE

We will teach you home care. We are hiring someone who has spent a career building processes inside a live operation and can show that those processes still run.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, business administration, or a related business field. An MBA is a plus.

- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher.

- At least five years in operations, with at least three of them building and improving processes, for example in process excellence, operational excellence, or quality in a BPO or another high-volume operation.

- At least 18 months with one of your last two employers.



THE JOB

You will:

- Write down how each part of the operation works today, step by step, from referral to cash.

- Find where the work breaks and fix the process that lets it break.

- Write procedures the team can follow, with an owner, a time limit, and a measure for every step.

- Train the team on each new procedure and check that it is followed.

- Report the numbers that show whether each procedure is working.

- Follow up on every open item, every time, until it is closed.



THE OPA STANDARD

1. Attention to detail. You catch the wrong date, the missing step, and the number that does not add up.

2. Self-starter. You find the broken process before anyone assigns it to you.

3. Follow-up. Every item, every time, without fail.

4. Coachability. When you are corrected, your next piece of work shows the correction.

5. Lagniappe. A little bit extra: one more check, done because the client needed it.



WHOSE SIDE YOU ARE ON

Senior people at OPA act for the company. When a team member asks for more pay, fewer hours, or a lower standard, your job is to get the facts and d
 what the company needs. You may recommend a change in pay or hours when you can show what it does for the company's results and what it costs. Speaking for the employee against the company is not part of this job.



HOW WE CONTROL THE WORK

- Every call and
 is recorded, transcribed, and evaluated. Problems found reach me the same day.

- Financial and operating reports are produced daily and weekly.

- No client or caregiver information is ever entered into an AI tool. We use AI, and we expect you to think, write, and d
 without it.



WHO SUCCEEDS IN THIS JOB

You find the broken step before anyone points to it, write the fix down, and check a week later that the team is still following it. You tell a team member exactly where their work falls short, and the procedure is followed the next day. Your numbers hold up when someone checks them. You close every open item without being reminded. When you learn something I will not want to hear, you tell me the same day, with the evidence.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

If you hand work back when it gets hard, you will fail here. If you cannot write a procedure without an AI tool writing it for you, you will fail here. If you see yourself as the team's advocate to management, you will fail here. If you cannot be available for the full US Eastern business day, and on weekends when planning requires it, this job is not for you.



PAY

USD 2,000 per month, paid in two equal halves: the first sent on or before the 1st and the second sent on or before the 15th. Full-time and long-term. This is the offer. There is no range.



HOW TO APPLY

Read every instruction. Following them is part of the test.

- Use this subject line: Process Excellence, your full name, and your Lean Six Sigma belt.

- Include a link to your resume that opens without requesting access.

- List your degrees with the school and year for each.

- List your last three employers with start and end month and year, and one line on why you left each.

- List every hour, weekdays and weekends, in US Eastern time, that you cannot work.

- No cover letter. Answer the five questions below, numbered, in under 700 words total.

- Applications that skip any of the above will not be read.

- We may reply with one follow-up question. Answer it within 24 hours.



QUESTION 1

Describe a process you built that is still running without you. What was it, how many items went through it per day or week, what were the numbers before and after, and how do you know it still runs?



QUESTION 2

Here is how a scheduler describes what happens today when a caregiver calls out:

"She usually texts whichever scheduler she knows, sometimes the night before and sometimes an hour before the visit. That scheduler checks AxisCare for someone available and starts calling. If she finds someone, she updates the shift. If not, she posts in the group chat. Sometimes the client's family is told and sometimes not. At the end of the day, my wrap-up says call-outs were handled."

OPA rules: a new caregiver may not call out in her first 90 days except when she or her child is admitted to a hospital, and OPA pays for rideshare so a caregiver can still reach a booked shift.

Write the procedure you would give the team: the steps in order, the owner of each step, the time limit for each, and the one number you would report every day to show the procedure is working.



QUESTION 3

Describe a time the people doing the work did not follow a procedure you wrote. How did you find out, what did you do, and what happened to the numbers?



QUESTION 4

Describe a time someone senior to you corrected your work. What exactly was wrong, what did you change, and how did your next piece of work show the change?



QUESTION 5

A coordinator tells you she is working too many hours, is underpaid, and that the team agrees with her. What do you find out first, what do you d
, and what exactly do you tell her?

THE JOB

You make the social posts and ads for our clients, which are local businesses (for example a painter, a clinic, a realtor). You do not d
 the plan: we give you the plan for each client, and you turn it into finished posts and ads. We check your work before it goes out, and we give you more freedom as you earn it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH WEEK

1. Make and schedule social posts for 3 to 5 local-business clients, from a set plan. For each client: write the captions, make or choose the pictures, and schedule them in our scheduling tool. We approve before anything goes live.

2. Make ads from reference ads. We show you an ad that works. You remake it for our client's business using AI image and video tools: still (static) ads and short video ads. You follow our written steps and check every result for wrong text, odd hands or faces, and anything that is not true about the business.

3. Send a short note at the end of each work day: what you finished, what is left, and any question.

4. Other work as you learn. This role grows. Once you are comfortable with posts and ads, we train you on other kinds of work for our clients (for example simple website updates, research, weekly numbers and general admin). We are looking for someone who wants to do more than one kind of job.



WHAT WE EXPECT (PLEASE READ THIS PART)

- Hours: 1 hour a day, Monday to Friday, while you are in paid training. After training, 2 hours a day, Monday to Friday. We tell you when training is finished.

- Your daily hour is a fixed hour we agree with you, between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern Time, Canada). Be at your computer for that hour every day, because that is when we answer questions, give feedback and approve your work. In your application, tell us which hour in that window you can do every day, and what time that is where you live.

- Please check the time zone before you apply. In the Philippines, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time is 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM now, and 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM from mid-March 2027 (Canada's clocks go forward; the Philippines' do not). The hours that suit the Philippines best are the end of our window: early morning, about 5:00 to 7:00 AM Philippine time now. Only apply if one of those hours really works for you every day. If it does not, please do not apply.

- Replies: you answer our messages within 24 hours, every day you are working. If you are stuck, sick or your internet is down, tell us the same day. Going quiet for days is the one thing we cannot work with.

- Paid for logged time only. You track your time in a free time tracker (we show you how). Time that is not logged is not paid. Please do not log time you did not work.

- English: clear, friendly written English. You can write a short caption in a natural voice and a short message without help. There are no phone calls, so we do not test spoken English.

- Equipment: a computer you can use for editing, stable internet and a backup if it goes down (for example a phone hotspot).

- Honesty with AI tools: you tell us which tools you used and you never present AI pictures of real work or real people as real. Clients' real photos stay real.



WHAT YOU GET

- Pay of CAD $3.50 per hour (Canadian dollars).

- Paid training: your first days are paid, with detailed written step-by-step guides for every task, and live help from us.

- A paid trial of 2 weeks. After the first week we sit down and review your work together. If it goes well, we move to long-term work with a monthly review.

- A clear path to more work: when you do well we add more hours and more types of work (more clients, more ad types). How fast depends on the work you show us.



HOW WE START

1. A short test task (under 1 hour) before we talk. We send the details to people we shortlist.

2. A video call of about 20 minutes, at your daily hour.

3. The paid trial.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word SOCIAL, so we know you read to the end. Then answer these 5 questions. Applications that skip them will not be read.

1. Which one hour between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM Toronto time can you do every day, Monday to Friday? What time is that where you live? Do you have another job or study that overlaps? What is your backup if your power or internet goes down?

2. Show us 2 or 3 things you have made: social posts, ads, short videos or pictures. Links please. Tell us which AI tools you used for each, and what you did by hand.

3. Imagine we give you an ad for a plumber and you must remake it for a local bakery. Write 3 to 5 short steps for how you would do it.

4. You are stuck on a task and the person who can help is asleep. What do you do, and what do you send us, and when?

5. Tell us about a mistake you once made in a post or ad. How did you find it, and what did you change?



Also confirm you are happy with CAD $3.50 an hour.



After we read your answers, shortlisted people get a short test.

title: GoHighLevel Onboarding Specialist - SMS Account Setup
description:
About us



King CRM is SMS software for land wholesalers, built on GoHighLevel. It includes an in-house AI acquisitions agent that texts and qualifies sellers. Our done-for-you clients pay us to build and run their whole acquisitions system. We’re onboarding 5+ new clients every week and need one person to own account setup from start to finish.



The role



You take each new client account from “A2P approved” to fully live and sending at volume by day 14. You aren’t doing sales or support. Your job is to make sure every account is set up perfectly, ramped safely and handed off on time.



What you’ll do



Build the sub-account: Load our master snapshot onto each new client sub-account, then check that every pipeline, workflow, custom field, custom value and template came through correctly.

Configure from the client questionnaire: Each client fills out an install questionnaire. You set up their custom values, scripts, markets and preferences to match it exactly.

Phone numbers and wallet: Buy and connect LC Phone numbers. Route every number to our AI receptionist. Set wallet auto-recharge (minimum $50) and confirm billing is live.

Prepare and upload leads: Clean, format, tag and upload the client’s lead lists plus our warm-up lead lists. Make sure every lead is in the right pipeline and workflow.

Ramp up sending: Move each account through the LC Phone sending levels, from 500 texts/day up to 3,500/day by day 14. Raise volume only when error rates and opt-outs are healthy.

Watch deliverability daily: Check error rates, carrier blocks (Error 30007), opt-outs and restriction history. Flag problems right away, before carriers flag the account.

Follow compliance rules: Keep sending within quiet hours (8am–9pm in the lead’s time zone) and make sure opt-outs and DNC requests are honored.

QA and handoff: Run a full pre-launch checklist: test texts, workflow triggers, AI agent routing and Slack alerts. Then hand the account to our client success team with a short summary.

Keep SOPs current: Document what you do and help improve the onboarding SOPs as we scale.



Requirements



At least 1 year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You must be comfortable with sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, custom fields/values, pipelines and LC Phone.

Understand A2P 10DLC and SMS deliverability (sending limits, carrier filtering, opt-outs).

Very detail-oriented. One wrong setting can get a client’s numbers blocked.

Strong written English and clear updates in Slack.

Able to manage several client accounts at once, each at a different stage, without dropping anything.

Reliable internet and a backup power source.



Nice to have



Experience with real estate or land wholesaling SMS campaigns

Experience setting up or working alongside AI agents in GHL

Data cleanup and list formatting in Google Sheets or Excel

Familiarity with Slack, Loom and Google Workspace



What we offer



Long-term, full-time role with a fast-growing US company

Performance bonus for accounts launched on time with healthy deliverability

Room to grow into an onboarding lead as we scale

Direct work with the founders



How to apply



Use the subject line “RAMP READY – [Your Name]”. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



In your application, include:



Your GoHighLevel experience: how long, and what you’ve built

A short answer: “A client’s account is ramping and their error rate suddenly jumps. What do you do?”

A Loom video (5 min max) walking through a GHL sub-account or workflow you’ve set up

Nolters Gold is a U.S.-based solid gold jewelry brand selling 10K and 14K gold jewelry through Shopify, Etsy, and eBay. We've been in business for four years and are growing steadily. We're looking for an experienced paid ads specialist to manage and improve our Meta and Google advertising.



About the Role

We currently spend approximately $4,000–5,000/month on ads and use AdScale for campaign automation. You will monitor performance, catch issues the automation misses, test new creatives, and keep our tracking and product feed healthy. This is a long-term, part-time position.

• Proven experience running paid ads for jewelry brands (required)

• Hands-on experience with both Meta Ads and Google Ads, including Performance Max

• Experience with Google Merchant Center and Shopify

• Solid understanding of pixel/CAPI and conversion tracking

• Clear written English and reliable communication

Compensation

• Base pay: $8–$10/hour, depending on experience. During the 3-month probation period, pay is 80% of the agreed hourly rate.

• Monthly performance bonus: A fixed bonus each month when our Shopify store reaches set monthly sales targets. Higher targets earn a higher bonus.

• Profitability condition: The bonus is paid only when the month's overall ROAS is 4.0 or higher.

• Sales targets and bonus amounts are agreed at hiring and adjusted for peak seasons and major promotions.



Work Details

PART-TIME COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER: $450 BASE + $8 PER ATTENDED DEMO + $100 PER CLIENT



Remote | 20 Hours/Week | US Business Hours



IMPORTANT: Applications that skip the steps in HOW TO APPLY (bottom of this post) won't be considered.



ABOUT US



Optemate is a Pennsylvania-based web development and AI automation company. We give local service businesses (HVAC, auto repair, contractors, gyms, home services) a professionally built demo website for free. If the owner likes it, they pay $100/month to keep it live. If not, they owe nothing.



It's a simple offer that's easy to explain and easy to book.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call business owners from qualified lead lists we provide. No prospecting needed.

- Pitch the free demo website and book short demo calls on our team's calendar.

- Log calls in our tracker and hit 75+ dials per shift.



Our team handles the demos, closing, and any upsells like SEO, Google Business Profile, and automations. We provide a US calling number, lead lists, and call scripts.



SCHEDULE



Monday-Friday, 9 AM-1 PM US Eastern (20 hours/week). Fixed, not rotating.

In Philippine time, that's 10 PM-2 AM during US standard time and 9 PM-1 AM during US daylight saving time.



These are the hours US business owners are most likely to answer.



PAY



- $450/month base, paid twice monthly ($225 per payment)

- $8 per attended demo. The owner must join the call. You earn it whether or not they buy.

- $100 per new client, paid once their first payment clears. This applies to any client who signs within 30 days of a demo you booked.

- $300 bonus every time 10 of your booked demos become paying clients.



Commissions are paid on the next pay date. Base pay starts on day one, including the two-week trial. The trial is a ramp-up period: aim for 75+ dials per shift and 3 demos booked by the end of week two. We'll coach you along the way, and if you're close and improving, we'll extend the trial rather than end it.



EXAMPLE MONTHLY EARNINGS



- Getting started: 10 attended demos, 2 clients = $730

- Solid: 15 attended demos, 4 clients = $970

- Strong: 22 attended demos, 8 clients = $1,426



GROWTH



We review performance at 90 days. Callers who consistently hit targets and convert demos move toward full-time hours and a higher base. We're looking for a long-term working relationship.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 1 year of cold calling, appointment setting, or outbound sales to US businesses.

- Clear spoken English, strong written English, and a confident phone presence.

- Stable internet (25+ Mbps), a quiet workspace, and a headset with a microphone.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, and calendar tools. CRM experience is a plus.

- Able to work the 9 AM-1 PM ET shift every weekday.

- Comfortable hearing "no" dozens of times per shift while staying friendly and professional.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Senior Amazon Wholesale VA / Account Growth Manager
description:
I am looking for a highly experienced, reliable, and proactive Amazon Wholesale VA who has a proven track record of scaling Amazon seller accounts into consistent **$20,000–$100,000+ monthly profit businesses.**



I have previously worked with several VAs, so I understand the difference between someone who simply completes assigned tasks and someone who genuinely understands how to grow an Amazon business. I am looking for the latter.



This is not an entry-level position. I need someone who knows what they are doing, takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates consistently, and can operate independently without constant supervision.



What I'm Looking For



- Proven experience scaling Amazon wholesale accounts, ideally to $20K–$100K+ in monthly net profit.

- Strong experience sourcing profitable wholesale products and establishing relationships with legitimate, reputable wholesale suppliers and distributors.

- Experience working with established brands and suppliers, including opportunities similar to **Hello Pharmacist** and other quality wholesale accounts.

- Ability to identify profitable, less-saturated brands and products with sustainable demand.

- Strong understanding of ROI, profit margins, Buy Box competition, sales velocity, inventory management, and pricing strategies.

- Experience identifying new wholesale accounts and negotiating or establishing supplier relationships.

- Ability to develop and execute a sourcing strategy that consistently brings profitable inventory into the business.

- Experience managing and growing an established Amazon Seller Central account.

- Ability to recognize opportunities, solve problems, and make strategic recommendations without waiting to be told what to do.



 Our Sourcing Strategy



I am specifically looking to expand into quality wholesale accounts and brands with long-term potential.



I am NOT interested in continuing to focus heavily on oversaturated opportunities like KeHE. I want to move toward better wholesale relationships, stronger brands, less competitive products, and opportunities that provide sustainable margins.



The goal is to build a much larger and more profitable wholesale operation rather than constantly competing over the same oversaturated products as everyone else.



Expectations



- Extremely reliable and consistent. Dependability is non-negotiable.

- Strong communication and regular progress updates.

- Proactive problem-solving and independent decision-making.

- Ability to meet deadlines and follow through on commitments.

- High attention to detail when analyzing products and calculating profitability.

- Must be results-driven and understand that the ultimate goal is growing net profit.

- Must be able to demonstrate previous results, not just claim experience.



Compensation



I am willing to pay above-average hourly rates for someone with advanced experience and a proven ability to scale Amazon wholesale businesses.



I would rather pay more for someone who knows what they are doing, produces results, and can help grow the business than hire someone at a lower rate who requires constant oversight.



Compensation will depend on experience, demonstrated results, and the level of expertise you bring to the business.



 To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have with Amazon Wholesale?

2. What is the largest Amazon account you have personally helped scale?

3. What were the monthly sales and, more importantly, monthly net profits you helped achieve?

4. What wholesale distributors and brands have you successfully sourced from?

5. Have you established wholesale accounts with reputable brands or distributors? Please provide examples.

6. What tools do you use for product research, sourcing, and profitability analysis?

7. How would you approach scaling an existing wholesale account to $20K–$100K+ in monthly net profit?

8. Can you provide examples, references, or verifiable results from previous clients?



*Please only apply if you have substantial, hands-on Amazon Wholesale experience. I am looking for someone who can help take an existing business to the next level, not someone who is learning the wholesale model on the job.

title: E-commerce Customer Support & Operations VA (UK Fashion dropshipping store – Shopify) – $4–$5/hr
description:
We are Kinsley & Co (
), a fast-growing UK women’s fashion brand specializing in outerwear, winter coats, knitwear, and seasonal collections. We are looking for an experienced, sharp, and commercially aware Customer Support & Operations Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.   



Please read carefully before applying — this is a demanding, high-volume role:

We operate on a dropshipping model, which means our inbox gets high daily
 volume — including urgent WISMO ("Where is my order?") questions, sizing issues, delivery delays, return requests, and frustrated customers. This role is genuinely challenging and requires someone who is fast, calm under pressure, and able to handle high ticket pressure without panicking or blindly giving away refunds.   This is not a basic "copy-paste" support job, and we do not hire beginners or applicants who rely on AI-generated replies. We need a true e-commerce professional who can independently manage our customer inbox, follow a strict SOP, protect customer satisfaction while keeping our margins healthy, and coordinate directly with our fulfilment partners to resolve delivery and product issues from start to finish.   



Compensation & Path to Manager:

Starting pay is $4.00 – $5.00 USD/hour, and pay is always open for discussion for the right person. We are not just looking for an agent — we want to find someone who truly fits our brand and grow you into a Customer Support Manager role over time. However, that position has to be earned: you will need to prove your speed, accuracy, commercial judgment, and ownership on the front line first.   



Strict Verification & Live Testing:

Every claim in your application will be verified. Shortlisted candidates will go through a focused 10–15 minute video interview where we will actively question your past e-commerce metrics, test your actual hands-on Shopify workflow, and put you through unprepared, real-life customer and refund scenarios on the spot. Only apply if you have genuine, proven high-volume e-commerce customer support experience and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Video Processing Virtual Assistant — Easy Task, Long-Term Growth Opportunity
description:
**Pay:** $0.10 USD per completed video  

**Volume:** 60–100 videos daily  

**Workload:** Approximately 1–2 hours daily, depending on processing and transfer speeds  

**Location:** Remote (Philippines preferred)  

**Start Date:** Immediately



### ABOUT THE POSITION



I'm a US-based business owner running multiple successful social media and e-commerce operations, and I'm looking for **one reliable, motivated individual** to join my growing team.



This is NOT a traditional video editing position.



We've already built custom software that automates nearly the entire editing process. Your job is simply to operate our system, ensure the results are correct, and return the completed files.



**The work is straightforward. The expectations are high.**



### YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Download raw video files from Google Drive.

2. Upload them into our automated editing software.

3. Review the results and remove any incorrect or bad clips.

4. Export the completed videos.

5. Upload the finished files to the designated Google Drive folder.

6. Confirm that all assigned videos are completed on time.



That's it! No complicated editing, special effects, or advanced editing experience required.



Each video typically requires less than one minute of hands-on processing once you've learned our system.



### COMPENSATION



- $0.10 USD per successfully completed video.

- Expected volume: 60–100 videos per day.

- Estimated daily earnings: $6–$10, depending on volume completed.

- Weekly payments based on completed video count.

- Training and access to our software provided.



This is a small, consistent daily workload, ideal for someone looking for additional income and an opportunity to establish themselves within a growing business.



### WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



I care much more about your attitude, discipline, and reliability than your resume.



**You MUST be:**



- **Extremely reliable:** If you commit to a deadline, you meet it.

- **Punctual:** You take schedules and turnaround times seriously.

- **Fast and efficient:** You work with urgency without sacrificing accuracy.

- **Tech-comfortable:** You can learn new software quickly and troubleshoot basic issues.

- **Equipped with fast, stable internet:** You'll be downloading and uploading a large volume of video files daily.

- **Detail-oriented:** You catch mistakes rather than sending unfinished work.

- **Independent:** You don't need someone constantly reminding you to do your job.

- **Growth-minded:** You want to improve your skills, prove your value, and take on bigger responsibilities.



If a problem comes up, I expect you to communicate early and help find a solution.



### OPPORTUNITY FOR GROWTH



I'm not just looking for someone to process videos.



I'm building a team, and I'm constantly looking for dependable people who can take on more responsibility.



Several positions within my business involve operations, content management, e-commerce, and team leadership.



**This is the position I'm hiring for TODAY.** However, if you consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, great communication, and a strong work ethic, you'll be someone I consider first as additional opportunities become available.



Growth is earned through performance, not promised based on time worked.



### HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



I receive many applications. Generic copy-and-paste responses will not be considered.



To apply, answer ALL five questions:



1. What is your current internet DOWNLOAD and UPLOAD speed in Mbps? Include a screenshot of a recent speed test.

2. What computer do you use? Include its basic specifications.

3. Can you consistently process 60–100 videos daily and meet an agreed-upon deadline?

4. Tell me about a time you had repetitive work to complete. How did you make sure you stayed accurate and consistent?

5. Why do you believe you'd be a valuable long-term addition to my team?



**IMPORTANT:** Begin your application with the exact words **"READY TO SCALE"** so I know you've read this entire listing.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small **paid trial assignment** to demonstrate accuracy, communication, and turnaround speed.



I'm hiring immediately.



**If you're dependable, fast, motivated, and ready to prove yourself, I want to hear from you.**

title: Experienced Credit Specialist / Credit Dispute Specialist
description:
NextGen Credit Solutions is looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Credit Specialist to join our growing team.



We are seeking someone who already understands the credit repair industry, knows how to properly prepare and process credit disputes, and has hands-on experience communicating directly with the three major credit bureaus.



The ideal candidate must have excellent customer service skills, strong communication abilities, and the confidence to make phone calls to credit bureaus to follow up on disputes, investigate reporting issues, and obtain updates.



**This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already has experience in credit repair and dispute processing.**



## Job Responsibilities



- Review consumer credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Identify inaccurate, outdated, unverifiable, and potentially unauthorized information.

- Prepare professional credit dispute letters.

- Understand the credit dispute and reinvestigation process.

- Submit and track credit bureau disputes.

- Make outbound phone calls to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Follow up directly with credit bureaus regarding pending disputes and investigation results.

- Communicate with creditors and collection agencies when necessary.

- Monitor dispute results and update client files.

- Maintain accurate records of dispute activity and client progress.

- Provide excellent customer service and respond to client questions.

- Follow company procedures and applicable consumer protection laws.



## Required Qualifications



Applicants MUST have:



- Previous experience working in the credit repair or credit services industry.

- Hands-on experience preparing and processing credit disputes.

- Knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA).

- Experience reviewing credit reports from all three major credit bureaus.

- Experience calling credit bureaus to discuss disputes and reporting issues.

- Excellent customer service and client communication skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Experience using credit monitoring or credit repair software.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with credit repair companies.

- Familiarity with credit dispute management software.

- Experience handling reinvestigation requests.

- Knowledge of collection accounts, charge-offs, late payments, inquiries, and other negative credit reporting.

- Experience documenting dispute outcomes and maintaining client records.



 How to Apply



To be considered, please answer the following questions in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have working in the credit repair industry?

2. Have you personally prepared and submitted credit disputes? Please explain your experience.

3. Have you called Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion directly? What types of issues have you handled over the phone?

4. Are you familiar with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)?

5. What credit repair or dispute management software have you used?

6. Have you worked directly with clients and handled customer service inquiries?

7. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

8. Are you available to work full-time during U.S. business hours?

9. contact information



We look forward to hearing from qualified applicants!
