title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, transportation tracking, or similar operations, with an understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and Hours of Service.

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and proper prioritization in a live dispatch environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across Zoom, chat, and
, with a minimum typing speed of 45 WPM.

• Highly detail-oriented with sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to operate effectively in high-volume communication environments.

• Team oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a willingness to follow established processes, accept feedback, and collaborate without resistance or ego.



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Hands-on leadership with direct feedback, coaching, and support.

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.

• Performance recognition with advancement potential for strong contributors.

title: US Tax Manager
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

*Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

title: FULL-TIME CPA ACCOUNTANT — QUICKBOOKS ONLINE & RECONCILIATION CONTROLS (NIGHT SHIFT)
description:
Salary: USD 905–1,105 per month, depending on verified job-related QuickBooks Online experience, credentials, assessment results, and schedule readiness

Type: Full time, 40 productive hours per week, Monday–Friday

Schedule: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines; includes a scheduled 60-minute meal/recovery break)

Location: Remote, Philippines-based



About Brown Management



Brown Management is a California Licensed Professional Fiduciary firm. We support trust administration, estate settlement, probate, and conservatorship matters through careful records and clear financial controls. We are not a law firm. This is not a legal-advice role.



About the role



We are hiring a Philippines-based CPA with strong QuickBooks Online (QBO) skills to prepare reconciliations, reports, and well-documented workpapers for review by our Fiduciary Accounting Lead. This is not a data-entry job. Every number you prepare must trace to its source document. You will prepare, reconcile, document, and escalate. You will not make payments. You will not access bank accounts. You will not approve your own corrections. You will not make legal, tax, court, billing, client-communication, or final reporting decisions. Authorized Brown Management staff retain those decisions.



This is a long-term financial-controls career opportunity. You receive a structured 90-day ramp-up and written feedback at 30, 60, and 90 days. Advancement follows accuracy, source discipline, safe data handling, sound escalation, successful work under review, and business need. Advancement is not automatic. Advancement does not expand financial authority.



What you will do



- Prepare bank, credit-card, and other assigned-account reconciliations from approved source records.

- Run QBO Class Summary, Project Profitability, General Ledger, and Transaction Detail reports using the correct dates, filters, accounting basis, Classes, and Projects.

- Review transaction coding for account, Class, Project, memo, date, payee, amount, and support. Record proposed corrections for review.

- Match invoices, bills, and payment records. Identify duplicates, missing support, timing differences, and open items.

- Organize permitted source documents for cost and contract reports. Escalate unclear items rather than guess.

- Write and improve reconciliation checklists and SOPs.

- Use approved research or AI tools only within data rules. Validate every result against source records.



Technical skills — required



- Philippine CPA credential. State the credential and issuing body. Brown Management verifies the credential only after a conditional finalist decision and with notice and consent.

- Current QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification, or at least two years of hands-on QBO controls work. Every shortlisted candidate completes the same synthetic assessment.

- Hands-on experience with reconciliations, month-end-close support, general-ledger review, financial reporting, and QBO Classes and Projects.

- Working knowledge of U.S. accrual accounting and GAAP concepts as they apply to reconciliation and reporting. U.S.-client experience helps but is not required.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Reliable internet, a private workspace, and willingness to use multi-factor authentication and documented secure-work practices.



Helpful experience



Experience in trust or estate work, law firms, wealth management, professional services, nonprofit or grant work, government contracting, or multi-project accounting may help. Experience with QBO Advanced, job costing, Class or Project reporting, 2 CFR 200 documentation, audit-ready workpapers, or SOP writing may help.



What good work looks like



- You work carefully with numbers. You explain what you found, how you proved it, and what remains open.

- You say, “I need the source or a reviewer’s direction before I classify or change this,” rather than guess.

- You raise a material issue early, before a deadline is missed.

- You handle confidential financial information carefully. You never share passwords or restricted data.

- You can reliably work the stated overnight schedule. You want to develop financial-controls and process-improvement capability over the long term.



Schedule and compensation



The role is Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time. The role includes eight productive hours and a scheduled 60-minute meal or recovery break. In the Philippines, this is normally 12:00 AM–9:00 AM PHT while the U.S. is on daylight time. In the Philippines, this is normally 1:00 AM–10:00 AM PHT during U.S. standard time. Please confirm that you can work this continuing overnight schedule.



The direct pay range is USD 905–1,105 per month. The range depends on verified job-related experience, credentials, assessment results, and schedule readiness. Final employment, payroll, leave, holiday, benefit, and equipment terms appear in the written offer. This posting does not promise any final term.



Hiring process



1. A person reviews every application using job-related evidence.

2. Shortlisted candidates complete the same 60-minute QBO reconciliation exercise using made-up data only.

3. Finalists have a structured technical interview.

4. Finalists have a final interview.

5. Credential and reference verification occurs only after a conditional finalist decision and with notice and consent.



Brown Management makes every final hiring decision. A platform recommendation or automated analysis does not make the decision.



How to apply



Use this exact subject line in your OnlineJobsPH application:



QBO CONTROL READY — [Your Full Name]



In a few numbered sentences, answer:



1. Your CPA credential and issuing body.

2. Your QBO experience and certification status.

3. The most complex Class or Project setup you have supported.

4. One reconciliation discrepancy you found and how you proved the cause.

5. One source-documentation process or SOP you created.

6. Confirmation that you can work the stated Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday.

7. How you check an AI-generated or internet-research result before you use it.

8. The accounting or controls skill you most want to build over the next two years.



Keep your OnlineJobsPH profile and résumé current. A missing instruction phrase alone does not d
 your application.



Applicant privacy notice



Effective for this recruitment only: This notice explains how Brown Management handles information submitted for this role. This notice accompanies the OnlineJobsPH job advertisement for this role. Brown Management will send this notice before requesting material outside OnlineJobsPH.



What we collect



Brown Management may collect information you choose to provide in your OnlineJobsPH application. This can include your name, contact details, résumé or profile information, work history, credentials, answers to the job questions, schedule availability, compensation expectations, and a non-confidential work explanation.



If you become a conditional finalist, Brown Management may request your consent before it verifies a CPA or QuickBooks credential. Brown Management may request your consent before it conducts a role-related reference check. Brown Management may collect other material only when that material is necessary for that stage.



Do not send: client information, former-employer confidential records, bank or account numbers, passwords, government ID, tax records, or other sensitive or restricted material through OnlineJobsPH or
. If Brown Management requests a work sample, use your own synthetic example or a safely redacted, authorized example.



Why we use it



Brown Management uses your information only to administer this recruitment. Brown Management may review your application, ask a job-related clarification question, identify candidates for a common synthetic assessment and structured interview, verify stated credentials after a conditional finalist decision and with notice and consent, d
 whether to make an offer, and document the recruitment process.



Brown Management reviewers read every application against job-related criteria and recommend candidates for interview. Brown Management makes the interview, final-selection, and offer decisions through human review. Brown Management does not make a hiring decision solely through automated processing.



Who may see it



Your initial application remains in OnlineJobsPH. Brown Management limits internal access to Keenan Brown, final hiring authority; Sherwin Estonilo, technical reviewer; Jan Alan Rosimo, candidate-data and access-control owner; and Alma Vidal, who processes recruitment
 received at 
 including messages from OnlineJobsPH.



No EOR or payroll provider receives candidate information before a conditional offer. Before any transfer, Brown Management identifies the provider, minimum necessary fields, purpose, retention rule, and applicable candidate notice or consent pathway. No provider transfer is currently planned.



How long we keep it



Applications are received through OnlineJobsPH. OnlineJobsPH keeps its own copy under its own privacy policy. Brown Management cannot delete that platform-held copy.



Brown Management keeps non-selected candidate materials outside OnlineJobsPH only for the recruitment purpose. Brown Management deletes that material within 90 days after the final hiring decision. Brown Management retains a runner-up’s material longer only with written consent and for the period stated in that consent.



If Brown Management selects you, Brown Management moves permitted hiring records to the applicable personnel or onboarding record. The final work arrangement governs that record’s retention.



Your choices and contact



You may ask what information Brown Management holds about you for this recruitment. You may request correction of inaccurate information. You may ask Brown Management to delete information that is no longer needed for the recruitment purpose.



Once this job is published,
 
 with the subject line “CPA privacy request” and identify the CPA & QuickBooks Financial Controls Specialist recruitment. For this recruitment, use that address for privacy requests only; applications sent there are not considered. Submit job applications only through OnlineJobsPH. Alma Vidal forwards privacy requests to Jan Alan Rosimo, the candidate-data and access-control owner, who logs and routes them through Brown Management’s restricted recruitment channel.



Security

Important: This notice describes Brown Management’s intended operating process for this recruitment. It does not alter rights or obligations under applicable law. Brown Management will update this notice if the actual channel, recipients, or retention practice changes.

title: # Social Media Growth Strategist — Proven Results Required
description:
# Social Media Growth Strategist — Proven Results Required



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Career Opportunity**



## WE'RE LOOKING FOR A GAME CHANGER



We are an established real estate brokerage in Ottawa, Canada, looking for someone who can **dramatically improve and grow our social media presence.**



We are NOT looking for someone who simply posts content, creates graphics, or manages a content calendar.



We want a **creative and strategic marketer who has already transformed the social media presence of another company—and can prove it.**



If you have taken a business from having an ordinary social media presence to one that generates significant attention, engagement, followers, leads, or sales, we want to talk to you.



## WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



You will take ownership of our social media growth and help determine:



- What content we should create.

- What we should and should not promote.

- What videos, Reels, and campaigns we should produce.

- How we can stand out from other real estate companies.

- How we can significantly increase engagement and audience growth.

- How social media can generate more buyer and seller leads.

- How AI can help us create better and more effective content.



We don't want to give you all the ideas.



**We are hiring you to bring the ideas.**



We want someone who studies our business, our audience, our competitors, and current trends and comes to us with strategies for growth.



## PROVEN RESULTS ARE REQUIRED



This is extremely important.



Please provide **2 examples of businesses or brands whose social media presence you personally helped grow or transform.**



For each example, tell us:



- Where was the account when you started?

- Where is it now, or where was it when you left?

- What strategy did YOU introduce?

- What content or campaigns did YOU create?

- What measurable results did you achieve?

- How long did those results take?

- What was your personal role in achieving them?



Please provide links to the social media accounts so we can review the work ourselves.



**If you cannot demonstrate previous measurable social media growth, this position is probably not the right fit for you.**



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



- At least 3 years of professional social media/digital marketing experience.

- A proven record of growing social media accounts.

- Strong strategic and creative thinking.

- Excellent video/Reel content skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Experience using AI to improve marketing and content creation.

- The confidence to recommend new ideas rather than wait for instructions.

- The ability to analyze results and change strategy when something isn't working.



Real estate experience is helpful, but **not required**. We care much more about your ability to grow a brand.



## ABOUT US



We are an established Ottawa real estate brokerage generating hundreds of buyer and seller leads every month through digital advertising.



We already have the business, leads, experience, and resources.



**What we're looking for now is someone who can help transform our social media presence and brand.**



This is a full-time, long-term opportunity for the right person.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



- Your resume.

- A 60–90 second video introducing yourself.

- Links to **2 social media accounts you personally helped grow.**

- Before-and-after results for those accounts.

- A brief explanation of the strategy you used and your personal role in achieving those results.



Please don't send us a long generic cover letter. **Show us what you've accomplished.**



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to review our current social media presence and tell us what they would change and how they would approach growing it.



## FINAL INSTRUCTION



To show that you've read this entire posting carefully, include the word **BrandBuilder** in the subject line of your application.



We're not looking for someone to maintain our social media.



**We're looking for someone who can change it.**

title: Outbound Sales Rep, B2B Cold Calling (Remote, Part-Time, Commission)
description:
About us

TableSide Media connects restaurants and local businesses across the US with social media creators who visit, create short-form content, and post it as an Instagram collaboration. We have over 1,000 creators and our clients keep re-signing.



The role

This is a cold calling role. You will spend your shift calling restaurant and local business owners and managers across the US, researching each business before you dial, running the intro conversation, and closing them on a campaign. You own the deal from first call through intake, contract, and payment, and you keep following up until it is signed.



What you will do

- Research each business before you call (website, Instagram, who the owner is) so every call is personal

- Make outbound cold calls to owners and managers, mostly restaurants, cafes, salons, and other local businesses

- Find the owner, keep every callback you promise, and follow up by call, text, and

- Close monthly plans and one-time campaigns

- Log every call and keep the CRM clean so any teammate can pick up your lead



What we are looking for

- Proven outbound B2B cold calling and closing experience. We are looking for people who have sold to business owners by phone and can tell us their numbers.

- Able to work US business hours (Central Time). Calls only happen when US businesses are open, so this is a must.

- Clear, natural spoken English. You sound like a real person, not like you are reading a script.

- Good listener. Short, confident pitch, then you listen.

- Comfortable handling objections without being pushy

- Reliable: you show up for every shift, reply on Slack, and meet every deadline

- Fast learner who is comfortable with a CRM and with using AI tools to research

- Quiet space, reliable internet, and a headset



Schedule and pay

- Part time, 4-hour shifts, about 20 hours a week, during US hours

- Calling windows are 8 AM to 11:30 AM and 1:30 PM to 5:30 PM Central Time (the restaurant's local time), with a break during the lunch rush

- $4 per hour base pay plus commission on every client you sign (8% on one-time campaigns, rising to 10% in strong weeks, plus a bonus for every monthly plan)

- Paid every 2 weeks through Wise

- Paid 3-day trial before we start long term



How to apply (applications missing any step will be skipped)

1. Put TABLESIDE as the first word of your application.

2. Tell us about your outbound sales background: companies, what you sold, who you sold to, how many dials a day, and your best result in numbers (deals closed, quota hit). Also tell us which US hours you can work.

3. Send a 1-minute voice note pitching TableSide Media to a restaurant owner as if they just picked up the phone. Do not read it.

4. Write exactly how you would reply to each of these owners:

   - "How much does this cost?"

   - "We already have a marketing company."

   - "We tried influencers before and it didn't do much."

   - "Sounds interesting, just send me some info."



Shortlisted applicants do a 20-minute live mock sales call.

Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 11 PM - 9 AM CST | Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST | Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

We are a full-time performance marketing agency working with a diverse portfolio of clients, from fast-growing DTC brands to B2B companies.

Experience with Shopify is required — this is non-negotiable

Creative eye to help improve ads, landing pages, and offers

Full-time, remote

title: Google Local Services Ads Expert for Remodelers
description:
Looking to bring in a part-time (5–10 hours weekly) Local Services Ads (LSA) manager. We are a marketing team supporting home remodeling contractors (kitchen, bathroom, addition, ADU and basement remodels) with local SEO, GoHighLevel automation and Google Local Services Ads. Our clients' LSA profiles are already approved and live. Your job is to run them well, week after week, so clients get fewer junk calls and more booked jobs. You'll start with 5 client accounts and work directly with Franklin, our founder.



Example tasks will include, but are not limited to:

-Reviewing every lead each week, including call recordings and messages

-Disputing bad leads wherever Google allows a credit

-Marking leads as booked estimates or signed jobs and sending booked-job feedback to Google

-Watching spend against the monthly budget and adjusting budget and bids

-Tuning the service area, job types, business hours and completed-project photos

-Checking answered-call rate and flagging clients who miss calls

-Checking badge, verification and policy status

-Monitoring Top Impression Rate and Absolute Top Impression Rate against benchmarks

-Building the monthly LSA report



Tech Stack We Use: Google Ads and the LSA dashboard, GoHighLevel, Slack, Zoom, ClickUp, Google Sheets & Docs



This is a part-time position with 5–10 hours per week, with the potential for an increase in hours and responsibilities as we add clients and based on work performance.



Weekly process

-Every Monday you'll review the previous week's leads for each client in the LSA dashboard, file disputes, mark booked estimates and completed jobs, and post a short update in Slack. You'll then work through the routine LSA checklist in ClickUp for each client, using the provided SOPs. The full routine is below.



Every week

-Review and rate every lead: listen to call recordings and read messages

-Dispute spam, wrong-service, out-of-area and duplicate leads, including handyman and small-repair requests, DIY and price--shopper calls, and wrong trades, wherever Google allows a credit

-Mark leads as booked estimates or signed jobs as they progress, and send booked-job feedback to Google

-Check spend against the weekly budget and cost per lead; adjust budget and bids

-Check answered-call rate and response time, and flag clients who are missing calls

-Check account health: badge status, verification, policy flags and suspensions



Every month

-Review the service area, job types, business hours and completed-project photos, and suggest tuning optimizations to the project manager

-Write the monthly report: leads, cost, cost per lead, estimates booked, signed jobs, disputes filed and won

-Add a short plain-English summary and two or three recommendations

-Watch license, insurance and background check renewals so no client loses a badge



As needed

-Collect booked-job answers from clients through our process (we ask each client one question: which leads became booked estimates or signed jobs, re-checked over the weeks a remodeling sale takes)

-Flag review issues that touch the client's Google Business Profile

-Pick up newly approved accounts from our onboarding team and take them over



How we work

-You work behind the scenes, inside our systems, with clear rules about when to act and when to ask.

-Access: You get access through our Google Ads manager account. No shared logins, and you never touch client payment details. Clients pay Google directly for lead costs.

-Client contact: Franklin owns client communication. You write the notes and recommendations; we send them.

-Scope: Each client starts with one campaign for their main service category. We add other categories only when we approve them.

-Process: You follow our SOPs and reporting template, and you help us improve them.

-Honest reporting: We never promise results. Reports show what came in, what it cost and what turned into booked jobs, good or bad.



Tell us the same day if:

-Spend runs more than 30% ahead of the monthly budget pace

-An account gets no leads for 7–10 days while its budget is live

-A badge, verification or policy issue puts an account at risk

-A client is missing calls and it's hurting results

-Google denies several disputes in a row



What we're looking for

We need someone who has run real LSA accounts for home service businesses, not just regular Google search ads. They're different platforms.

[1+] year of hands-on LSA management for remodelers or other high-ticket home service businesses with long sales cycles, with examples you can describe

Comfortable in both Google Ads and the LSA dashboard

Know how lead disputes work and what Google will and won't credit

Able to judge lead quality from call recordings and messages

Comfortable with the numbers: cost per lead,  budget pacing

A clear writer who can explain results to a contractor, not a marketer

Reliable: a steady weekly routine and a reply within one business day

Available for a weekly check-in during US Eastern business hours

You must carefully follow step-by-step standard operating procedures (SOPs) with a high rate of accuracy. A missed dispute window or a wrong budget change costs a client real money. We'll support you through the learning curve and work together to update any outdated steps, but this role requires consistent precision and attention to detail.



Bonus points

Experience with remodeling companies: kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs or basements

GoHighLevel (GHL) experience, or other CRM and automation tools

Call tracking experience, such as setting up and reading call data

Knowledge of sending booked-job or offline conversion data back to Google

AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting tools

Experience writing SOPs others can follow

The ability to complete tasks on time, communicate early and often, and be a problem solver are very important.



Tools and work setup

We give you what you need to start on day one.

Google Ads manager account access for each client you manage

Our SOPs and monthly report template

Access to our GoHighLevel CRM and call tracking, so you can see leads and booked jobs

Slack for questions and same-day flags, plus the occasional Zoom call



We are based in the USA, Eastern time. Check-ins with Franklin happen during normal US working hours (8 AM–5 PM ET), while routine tasks can be completed at your own discretion, as long as the weekly lead review is done by Monday 5pm EST.

You should have reliable internet with backup connectivity, a stable power source and a well-functioning computer.



Pay and contract terms

Pay: 10-15 per hour (based on experience)

Growth: More accounts mean more hours and more pay as we sign clients

Agreement: Independent contractor (1099) agreement, plus an NDA and a non-solicitation clause covering our clients

Client data: All client data, call recordings and account access stay confidential and stay with Notably Bravo

Trial: The first 30 days are a paid trial. Either side can end the agreement with 14 days' notice.



Your first 90 days

By day 90 you run your full account load on your own, and we rarely have to ask what happened.



Days 1–30 (paid trial)

Learn our SOPs, take over [1] account, run weekly lead reviews with Franklin checking your work

First monthly report delivered and approved



Days 31–60

Run [3] accounts, file disputes every week, send booked-job feedback to Google

Weekly routine runs without reminders; first recommendations tied to booked jobs



Days 61–90

Take on all 5 accounts, own the same-day flag process, suggest SOP improvements

Reports go out on time and Franklin only reviews the summary



What good looks like

Every lead reviewed every week

Bad leads disputed promptly

Monthly reports out by the 5th

No surprise budget overspend

Cost per lead holding steady or improving over time

Problems flagged the same day, never found by the client first



How to apply

If you're interested, please start your application with "LSA for Remodelers" followed by your favorite hobby. Also include, at the top, how many years you've managed Google LSA accounts. Include a link to your resume/CV and briefly share (2–3 sentences) why you'd be a great fit for this role. Applications missing these details will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Medical Biller
description:
Hiring: Experienced ABA Billing & Collections Specialist (Part-Time)



Company: Buzz ABA, LLC

Location: Remote – Philippines

Job Type: Part-Time

Work Schedule: 4 hours per day during US business hours (20 hours per week)

Compensation: Up to $10 USD/hour (negotiable for exceptional candidates)



About the Role



Buzz ABA is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and highly motivated ABA Billing & Collections Specialist to join our growing team.



We are looking for someone with extensive experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) billing, revenue cycle management (RCM), insurance collections, and accounts receivable (AR).



The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and capable of independently managing complex claims, resolving denials, and ensuring timely reimbursement.



This is not simply a claims submission role. We need someone who can take ownership of outstanding claims, identify root causes, resolve issues independently, and consistently follow through until payments are received.



Key Responsibilities

title: Part-Time Remote Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) / Registered Nurse (RN) | Pediatric Healthcare VA
description:
Part-Time Remote Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) / Registered Nurse (RN) 

Pediatric Clinical Care Coordinator 

Practice - Private Pediatric Practice

Location - Remote | Supporting pediatric patients in Montana

Position Type - Part-time only | Schedule and weekly hours to be agreed upon

Reports To - Pediatric Provider / Practice Leadership





About the Practice 

We are a pediatric practice committed to compassionate, whole-child care for children, teens, and young adults. Our team supports families through pediatric primary care, neurodevelopmental services, individualized care planning, and coordination for children with complex needs. 

We are seeking an organized, compassionate LPN or RN for a part-time, remote role that combines nursing judgment, excellent family communication, and hands-on clinical care coordination. This is a patient-facing nursing support position—not simply a scheduling or general virtual assistant role. 



Position Summary 

The Part-Time Remote LPN/RN Pediatric Clinical Care Coordinator will work closely with a pediatric provider to manage patient communication, follow up on labs and testing, coordinate referrals and outside records, support prescriptions and provider-directed orders, prepare visits, and close the loop on family care needs. The nurse will also assist with post-visit education, school-support documentation, and selected Direct Primary Care (DPC) membership workflows. 

Responsibilities will be assigned according to the individual’s active licensure, demonstrated competencies, approved written protocols, required supervision, and the laws of the state where the patient is located. The role does not include independent diagnosis, prescribing, or changes to the provider’s plan of care. 



Key Responsibilities 

Pediatric Nursing Communication & Clinical Message Management 

• Monitor and respond to parent/caregiver messages through Spruce, phone, and
; document encounters and ensure timely follow-through. 

• Gather relevant history, symptoms, medication information, and parent concerns; recognize red flags and escalate promptly according to written protocols. 

• For RN candidates: perform nursing assessments and protocol-based telephone/virtual triage when authorized, trained, and within applicable scope; coordinate disposition with the provider as required. 

• For LPN candidates: perform standardized, focused assessments and communicate findings under required supervision; route needs requiring independent nursing assessment or triage to the provider/RN. 

• Communicate provider-approved instructions in a clear, calm, family-centered manner, especially for families navigating developmental or complex pediatric needs. 



Medical Records, Chart Preparation & Visit Support 

• Request, retrieve, organize, and upload outside medical records, consult notes, hospital documents, school reports, and therapy records. 

• Prepare charts before visits by reviewing gaps in documentation, medication lists, pending tests, prior referrals, and relevant history. 

• Review provider documentation and Heidi-generated notes for action items; flag missing or unclear details rather than assuming clinical instructions. 

• Prepare and send accurate, provider-reviewed visit summaries and educational resources to families; document delivery in the EHR.

 

Laboratory, Imaging & Diagnostic Follow-Up 

• Maintain a reliable tracking system for pending labs, imaging, EEGs, MRIs, specialty testing, and outside results.

PEDIATRIC CLINICAL CARE COORDINATOR Page 1 

• Coordinate appointments and obtain missing results from outside facilities; promptly flag results requiring provider attention under practice policy. 

• Communicate results and follow-up instructions only after appropriate provider review or under approved nursing protocols; do not independently diagnose or alter treatment plans. 

Referral & Complex Care Coordination 

• Prepare, enter, and process provider-directed referrals to specialists, therapists, developmental services, diagnostic facilities, and community supports. 

• Track referral status, missing documents, appointment completion, and consult-note return; proactively follow up with facilities and families. 

• Help families access appropriate autism, ADHD, behavioral health, school-based, therapy, and other community resources consistent with provider recommendations. 



Prescription Refills, Orders & Supplement Follow-Up 

• Receive and review refill requests, verify key information, and prepare or process routine requests only within approved protocols, nurse scope, and provider authorization. 

• Prepare or enter provider-directed orders and referrals in Elation based on verified instructions, including action items captured in Heidi notes; route for provider review/signature as required. 

• Send Fullscript links and other supplement or educational links based solely on documented, provider-approved recommendations. 

• Escalate medication discrepancies, refill exceptions, safety concerns, or unclear instructions before taking action; never independently prescribe or change medications. 



Patient Education, School Letters & Family Resources 

• Reinforce provider-established care plans using approved patient education and nursing teaching appropriate to license and competency. 

• Draft IEP/504 accommodation letters, school forms, and parent-requested medical documentation for provider review, approval, and signature. 

• Compile and maintain practical, up-to-date resource lists for therapists, autism services, developmental supports, and related community programs. 



DPC Membership & Practice Operations Support 

• Help maintain DPC member records, enrollment status, and follow-up tasks in Elation. 

• Support DPC onboarding, member messaging, and care-coordination workflows; assist with insurance verification only while still needed by the practice. 

• Support documentation, task prioritization, and quality improvement to reduce provider administrative burden and improve continuity of care. 



Required Qualifications

• Current, unrestricted LPN or RN license with legal authority to provide nursing services to patients located in Montana (Montana license or qualifying Nurse Licensure Compact multistate privilege); maintain authorization for any other patient states served. 

• Graduate of an accredited practical or registered nursing education program, as applicable. 

• Recent experience in nursing, patient care coordination, clinical telephone support, pediatric care, or a related practice environment. 

• Ability to recognize escalation needs, practice within scope, follow approved protocols, and collaborate closely with the supervising provider. 

• Strong EHR documentation, written communication, organizational skills, and reliable remote-work habits. • Knowledge of HIPAA, confidentiality, secure remote access, and professional patient communications. 



Preferred Qualifications 

• Pediatric outpatient nursing, pediatric triage (RN), or care coordination experience. 

• Experience supporting children with autism, ADHD, developmental or behavioral concerns, PANS/PANDAS, or medically complex conditions. 

• Familiarity with Elation EHR, Spruce, Heidi, Fullscript, and digital task-tracking systems.

PEDIATRIC CLINICAL CARE COORDINATOR Page 2 

• Experience with labs, diagnostic testing, referrals, pharmacy requests, patient education, school letters, and family resource coordination. 

• Understanding of Direct Primary Care (DPC) or membership-based practice operations. 

• Current pediatric-focused life-support training where appropriate to the role. 



Ideal Candidate 

The right person combines the warmth and sound judgment of a pediatric nurse with the organization and persistence of a great care coordinator. They communicate with worried parents calmly, document thoroughly, recognize when the provider needs to be brought in, and take ownership of tasks until they are resolved. They are comfortable learning new systems, asking clarifying questions, and working independently within a clearly defined clinical framework. 



Clinical Scope, Supervision & Safety 

All nursing duties must remain within applicable state law, the clinician’s individual license and competence, and practice-approved policies. RNs may perform nursing assessment and approved triage consistent with their scope; LPNs contribute focused assessments and nursing care under the supervision required by Montana law. Neither role independently diagnoses, prescribes, interprets diagnostic results for treatment decisions, or changes medical care plans. Provider orders, refill approvals, supplement recommendations, and medical letters require appropriate provider authorization. Urgent or emergency concerns are escalated immediately under established protocols. 



Technology & Platforms 

Elation EHR • Spruce • Heidi • Fullscript • Secure
/phone • Referral and records systems • Online scheduling • Shared task management • Google Workspace or similar tools 



Typical Weekly Priorities 

• Prepare upcoming charts and follow up on missing records. 

• Review and route Spruce messages, calls, and
s; prioritize safety-related issues. 

• Track labs, MRIs/EEGs, referrals, and unreturned consultation reports. 

• Coordinate provider-directed orders, routine refills, patient education, and visit summaries. 

• Draft and route IEP/504 letters for approval; maintain family resource lists. 

• Update DPC member tasks in Elation and close care-coordination loops. 



Application Verification 

To confirm that you have carefully read the entire job description, please include the keyword PEDIATRICCARE in your application. You will be asked to enter this keyword in the application form.



Part-Time Schedule & Compensation 

This is a part-time, remote role. Weekly hours and coverage will be agreed upon during hiring. Compensation is based on LPN/RN credentials, relevant experience, and assigned responsibilities. 



How to Apply 

To apply, submit a resume, nursing license and compact status, part-time availability, and a brief summary of pediatric experience, remote communication skills, EHR use, and care coordination.

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

About Elite Processing Team



Elite Processing Team is a fast-growing U.S.-based mortgage company supporting mortgage brokers and licensed loan officers nationwide. We are expanding our remote team in the Philippines and hiring experienced Mortgage Loan Officer Assistants (LOAs) to work leads and build files for our licensed loan officers.



HIRING IMMEDIATELY – U.S. WHOLESALE MORTGAGE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

This is not an entry-level position. Applicants without U.S. mortgage experience will not be considered.



Position Details

Job Title: Mortgage Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) – U.S. Wholesale

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday | U.S. Business Hours (Eastern Time)

Reports To: Director of Operations

Start Date: Immediate (ASAP)



What You'll Do

- Work inbound and purchased U.S. mortgage leads by phone, text and

- Contact new leads quickly and follow up persistently

- Pre-screen borrowers: goals, timeline, occupancy, property, income type, estimated credit and assets

- Identify likely program fit (Conventional, FHA, VA, DSCR, Non-QM) for loan officer review

- Collect initial documents and build clean files in our LOS and wholesale lender portals

- Run preliminary scenarios in UWM EASE and other lender portals

- Schedule appointments and warm handoffs with the licensed loan officer

- Keep the CRM accurate: notes, status and next follow-up on every lead

- Re-engage aged and unresponsive leads

- Report daily activity: contacts, conversations, appointments, files started



Required Experience

- 2+ years of U.S. residential mortgage experience (LOA, LO support or processing)

- U.S. wholesale/broker channel experience

- Hands-on UWM experience – REQUIRED

- Experience calling and following up with U.S. borrowers

- Experience working leads in a CRM and dialer

- Working knowledge of Conventional, FHA, VA, DSCR, Non-QM, purchase and refinance

- Microsoft Outlook and Teams daily use – REQUIRED



Preferred

- Other wholesale lenders: NewRez, PennyMac TPO, Rocket Pro TPO, A&D, Plaza, LoanStream

- Encompass, Arive, LendingPad or similar LOS

- GoHighLevel, Jungo, Salesforce or similar CRM

- LendingTree, Zillow or aged lead experience



International (non-U.S.) mortgage experience alone does not qualify.



Communication Standards

This is a phone-heavy, borrower-facing role. You must have excellent spoken and written English, confident phone presence, and the persistence to follow up without being pushy. Leads should never go cold because no one followed up.



Who We're Looking For

Driven, organized, accountable for your own numbers, coachable, comfortable on the phone all day, available to start right away, and reliable during U.S. business hours.



What We Offer

- 100% remote, full-time, consistent schedule

- Performance bonuses on funded loans

- Steady lead flow – we provide the leads, you work them

- Support from our in-house processing and vendor teams

- Career path: LOA → Senior LOA → Team Lead → Sales Operations Manager



How to Apply

: 

Subject: LOA – Philippines – [Your Full Name]



Include:

- Updated resume

- Years of U.S. mortgage experience and your role(s)

- U.S. wholesale lenders you've worked with (UWM required)

- LOS, CRM and dialer platforms you've used

- Lead sources you've worked

- Average daily call volume in your last role

- A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself as if calling a new U.S. mortgage lead

- Your available hours, time zone and earliest start date



Do not apply without U.S. mortgage experience. Non-mortgage call center, general VA or non-U.S. mortgage work does not qualify.

title: Medical VA / Patient Scheduling & Telehealth Support (Athenahealth)
description:
Type of work: Full Time



Salary: $2.5/hour



Hours per week: 40



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila)



Job Description:



We are a US telehealth practice providing primary care and psychiatry to patients in New York. Most of our patients are seniors. We need a VA who is warm and confident on the phone and genuinely patient with older people.



You will be on calls most of the day. If you don't enjoy talking to people, this isn't the role.



What you'll do:



Call patients to schedule telehealth visits with our doctors

Book, reschedule, and cancel appointments in Athenahealth (we will train you)

Call patients before their visit to check them in, confirm their info and walk them through joining the video call

Patiently guide patients who struggle with technology. Many are 70+ and need to be walked through it slowly, one step at a time.

Confirm next-day appointments and follow up on no-shows

Update patient information in the system and document every call



Requirements:



Clear, easy-to-understand English, an 80-year-old American must be able to follow you without asking you to repeat

Real patience. Some calls take 15 minutes. That's normal.

Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement and complete HIPAA training

Reliable internet (25 Mbps minimum), backup internet, noise-cancelling headset, quiet workspace

Backup power

Committed to working US Eastern night shift long-term



Preferred but not required:



Any healthcare, medical VA, or call center background

EMR experience (Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Kareo, etc.)



What we offer:



Full training on our systems, no medical background required if you're a strong communicator

Long-term, stable role with a growing US practice

Pay review at 90 days based on performance



To apply:



Start your reply with the word ATHENA so I know you read this.



Then send:



A short paragraph about your phone/customer service experience

A 60-second video recording of yourself and your experience in the medical field

A screenshot of your internet speed test



No recording, no review.

title: AU SMSF Senior Accountant
description:

We are currently seeking a Senior Accountant to join our team, supporting a Perth-based accounting firm. This role will initially focus on Self-Managed Super Funds (SMSF), taking ownership of SMSF compliance work from start to finish. Once the SMSF workload is under control, the role will expand into general accounting and tax compliance across the firm's broader client base.



This is a great opportunity for an experienced accountant who enjoys taking ownership of their work. 



Key Responsibilities



SMSF



Prepare and review SMSF annual financial statements, tax returns and workpapers in BGL SF360.

Process and reconcile SMSF transactions, investment income, contributions, pensions and member balances.

Liaise with SMSF auditors and resolve audit queries to finalise annual compliance.

Ensure SMSF compliance with superannuation legislation and ATO requirements.

Correspond directly with client's and accountants in relation to SMSF and superannuation queries generally.

Assist with strategic planning, including review of client records and assisting with recommended strategies, assistance with collation of Statements of Advice, implementation of chosen strategies.



General accounting and tax compliance



Prepare and review financial statements in line with Australian accounting standards.

Prepare income tax returns and Business Activity Statements (BAS) for individuals, companies, trusts, SMSFs and partnerships.

Process annual financials for various entity types using Xero and XPM.

Support the development of tax planning figures and analysis.

Manage and respond to ATO correspondence and queries.

Perform account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.



Review, client service and workflow



Review work for accuracy and quality before finalisation.

Respond to client queries independently and build strong client relationships.

Manage your own workload and deadlines with minimal supervision.

Work collaboratively with internal team members to meet deadlines.

Stay updated with changes in Australian tax law, superannuation rules and accounting standards.



Required Skills & Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA or equivalent is an advantage.

Minimum 5 years of experience in Australian public accounting, including tax and financial statement preparation.

Proven hands-on experience with SMSF compliance work.

Experience in BGL SF360, Xero and XPM (Xero Practice Manager).

Strong understanding of Australian tax regulations, superannuation rules and accounting principles.

Experience reviewing work and working independently with minimal supervision.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills, confident handling client queries.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.

Client-focused mindset with a professional, approachable attitude.



Work Arrangement and Benefits



Employment type: Full-time, remote.

Hours: Aligned with Perth business hours (AWST).

Salary: PHP 110,000 – 140,000, depending on experience

Leave: 4 weeks paid leave per year, plus sick leave

Equipment: Laptop and all required software provided

title: WE'RE HIRING: EXPERIENCED MORTGAGE LOAN OFFICER ASSISTANT (LOA)
description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Mortgage Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) with a strong understanding of the U.S. mortgage process from application to closing.



This is NOT a basic data entry or general administrative position. We need someone who can actively support mortgage loan processing, understand various mortgage programs, identify potential issues, coordinate with lenders, and independently manage loan-related tasks.



Key Responsibilities

-Assist with mortgage applications, preapprovals, processing, underwriting, and closing.

-Review borrower documents, income, credit, assets, and loan requirements.

-Understand various mortgage loan programs, including Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, Jumbo, Non-QM, DSCR, Bank Statement, HELOC, and other specialized financing options.

-Track loan files, underwriting conditions, and outstanding documentation.

-Communicate with borrowers, lenders, processors, and underwriters.

-Identify missing requirements, anticipate potential issues, and proactively coordinate solutions.

-Manage loan pipelines and maintain accurate records in the Loan Origination System (LOS).



Qualifications

-Minimum 2 years of hands-on U.S. mortgage industry experience.

-Strong knowledge of mortgage processing, underwriting workflows, and various loan programs.

-Experience working with mortgage brokers, wholesale lenders, and lender portals.

-Familiarity with ARIVE LOS preferred.

-Ability to understand lender guidelines and documentation requirements for different loan products.

-Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Important

-We are looking for someone who understands HOW mortgage loans work—not someone who only uploads documents or enters data.

-Candidates must demonstrate real mortgage processing experience, knowledge of multiple financing programs, and the ability to proactively move loan files forward.



To Apply: Submit your resume, years of mortgage experience, loan programs handled, and mortgage systems you have used.

title: Process Design Assistant
description:
Process Design Assistant



Keeping it simple, the person for this position MUST have BOTH of the following:



-Property management operations experience (ops management; implementing, coordinating, or improving processes across leasing, resident services, or maintenance) AND/OR a high degree of technical capability (building automations, workflows, or CRM systems)

-AND the ability to communicate clearly and confidently in English with clients



If you have both of these, we would love to hear from you. More details are provided below.



This role IS: Hands-on and client-facing. The core challenge is turning how a property management company actually operates into processes that run reliably in its software, then walking clients through them with confidence. You'll thrive here if you enjoy both building the solution and explaining it.



This role is NOT: A solo, build-it-your-own-way job. If you get energized by making proven tools do more, rather than starting from scratch on your own, you'll fit right in. And if your background is purely accounting, or you'd rather build without talking to clients, this likely isn't the right fit.



Mission of the role



The objective of this position is to deliver the ProfitCoach Experience (customized solutions, ease of doing business, and extraordinary service) by designing, implementing, monitoring, and improving property management processes for multiple property management companies that use ProfitCoach services.

You'll work directly with property management clients and our internal team, so clear, confident communication matters as much as building skill.



Key responsibilities



Design and implementation (75%)

-Conceptualize and design processes for core property management operations, sales, new services, and client-specific needs.

-Implement and test processes within workflow automation software, validating functionality and ensuring reliable execution across connected systems.



Process optimization (10%)

-Analyze existing processes and identify areas for improvement in efficiency, task delegation, timelines, and automation.

-Review and optimize processes to align with PM Ops Standards, industry best practices, and client-specific nuances, ensuring consistent execution and eliminating redundancy across workflows.

-Process documentation (5%)

-Own process documentation, including creating, revising, and maintaining SOPs for internal use and client engagements.

-Translate processes into clear visual diagrams using tools like L
 to support team alignment, training, and scalability.



Quality assurance (5%)

-Ensure processes are designed and optimized in alignment with the PM Ops Standards and industry best practices.

-Implement measures to keep service quality consistent while handling custom scenarios and exceptions.

-Continuous improvement (5%)

-Champion a culture of continuous process development and improvement.

-Collaborate with internal teams to foster a mindset of efficiency and innovation.

-Stay current on emerging tools in the PM tech stack, assessing their potential and recommending solutions for client engagements.



Culture fit and core values

-Think Abundantly

-Own the Outcome

-Be Courageous

-Leverage Your Talents

-ADEPT Communication (Assess the need, Detail the solution, Energize the conversation, Provide closure, Tell the truth always)
