title: Executive & Operations Assistant, Healthcare Business (Remote)
description:
Executive & Operations Assistant, Healthcare Business (Remote, Full-Time)

Nov 16, 2026 
 Ali

About the role

I'm hiring my first Executive Assistant, someone with real healthcare business experience: a full-time, remote right hand who works US Eastern hours and is reachable on WhatsApp.

I own and operate a growing portfolio of healthcare businesses in New Jersey, from clinics to specialty practices, with new locations and ventures added regularly. My days are full of decisions, partners and moving parts, and I need someone who keeps everything else moving without me.

This role is about ownership, not instructions. When I hand you something, you own it from A to Z. You work out the steps, contact the right people, follow up and close it out. You come back to me only when you need a decision or clarity on a specific point.

Because this is my first EA, the role will be shaped together. You'll start with the core, and as I see what you're great at, your scope and responsibility grow with it.

What you'll do

The work will change as the businesses grow. These are the areas you'll cover.

Executive support

• Manage my calendar, inbox and communications across several businesses, and d
 what actually needs me

• Prepare agendas and briefs before meetings, and send action items and follow-ups after

• Be my point of contact for partners, vendors, advisors and staff, representing me professionally

• Track every open commitment and chase it until it is done

Finance and administration

• Create and send invoices, record payments and follow up on outstanding balances

• Process vendor bills, track due dates and make sure payments go out on time

• Track expenses, collect receipts and reconcile card statements

• Coordinate with our bookkeeper, accountant, payroll provider and banks across entities

• Keep financial records, contracts and documents organized and easy to find

Projects and operations

• Own projects end to end, such as opening a new location, launching a service or onboarding a vendor

• Manage vendors and contractors: get quotes, compare options, track deliverables and hold them to deadlines

• Build and maintain schedules, SOPs, checklists and trackers that keep teams consistent

• Keep a renewal calendar for licenses, insurance, contracts and filings, and flag anything at risk early

People and growth

• Support hiring: post roles, screen candidates, schedule interviews and coordinate onboarding

• Research prospects and partners, build outreach lists and manage follow-up

• Coordinate marketing and web contractors, and compile simple weekly reports on the numbers I track

Personal support (as needed)

• Appointments, reservations, travel, household vendors and personal errands

How this role will grow

You'll earn more ownership as trust builds. Strong performers move from assistant to operating partner.

Stage

Timing

What you own

Learn

Months 1–2

Calendar, inbox, follow-ups, scheduling and defined admin tasks

Own

Months 3–6

Invoicing and bills, vendor management, and full projects from start to finish

Lead

6 months+

Running operating rhythms across businesses, coordinating teams, and taking on new areas we agree on together

How we'll work

• WhatsApp for quick questions, approvals and anything urgent, with fast replies during working hours

• Daily end-of-day update: what's done, what's in progress and what needs my decision

• Weekly priorities call (about 20 minutes) to set the week and review open items

• One shared task tracker: every task lives there, not just in chat

• Bring answers, not only questions: when you need clarity, send your recommendation so I can reply yes or no

Acting on my behalf. You'll speak and act for me day to day. Decisions on contracts, legal matters, partner or deal terms, hiring and firing, and unapproved spending come to me first. Everything you see about my businesses, partners and finances stays confidential, and you'll sign an NDA before starting. You won't access patient records.

What you bring

• 2+ years supporting a US medical practice, clinic or healthcare business on the business side (operations, admin, billing or practice management, not clinical or charting work)

• Fluent, professional written and spoken English, confident on calls with US businesses

• A self-starter who takes initiative and finishes what you start without step-by-step direction

• 3+ years total as an executive assistant, operations coordinator or similar, ideally supporting a business owner directly

• Comfort switching between several businesses and priorities in a single day

• Hands-on experience with invoicing, bills and expense tracking (QuickBooks or similar)

• Sound judgment on when to act and when to ask, and complete discretion with confidential information

• Strong with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, spreadsheets and task management tools

• Available US Eastern hours, Monday to Friday, and on WhatsApp throughout the workday

Preferred

• Experience with multi-location practices, urgent care, specialty or wellness clinics

• Familiarity with practice management, EMR or billing systems, and with insurance, credentialing or payer processes

• Experience recruiting, onboarding or coordinating staff and provider schedules

• Experience managing vendors, contractors or new office openings

Logistics and how to apply

Item

Details

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday to Friday, core hours 9am–6pm US Eastern

Communication

WhatsApp,
 and phone

Location

Remote, with reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a headset

Pay

$10–14 USD/hour depending on healthcare experience, with increases as scope grows

Process

Short call, paid trial task, then a 90-day review

To apply, send:

1.  The healthcare businesses you've supported, the practice management, EMR or billing systems you've used, and one non-clinical problem you solved for a practice owner

2.  Three to four sentences about a task you owned from start to finish, and what you did that wasn't asked of you

3.  Your weekly availability in US Eastern time, and confirmation that you use WhatsApp

4.  A 1–2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

Applications without healthcare experience won't be considered.

Start your message with the word "Somerset" so I know you read the full post.

First 90 days

• Days 1–30: get set up on
, WhatsApp and the task tracker, take over my calendar and inbox, and start daily updates

• Days 31–60: take over invoicing and bills, and run your first projects end to end

• Days 61–90: write SOPs for your recurring work, and propose what you'll take on next

What success looks like: tasks I hand off come back done, not with a list of questions. Nothing slips without a heads-up. Partners and vendors hear back within one business day, and I spend less than 30 minutes a day directing your work.

title: Full-Time Cold Caller for US B2B Calls (9 AM to 5 PM EST) - Base + Uncapped Commission
description:

THE JOB

- Think for yourself. When a call goes off script, pivot and handle it. We don't hold hands.

- Full time, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.

- Start immediately.



PAY AND GROWTH

- Base pay: $250 per week, paid weekly.

- Commission on top, paid weekly, with no cap. The more you convert, the more you earn.

- Strong performers can move into other positions inside the company.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Fluent spoken and written English that US business owners understand easily, with minimal accent.

- Stable, reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

- A stable life. You show up every day, on time, and don't disappear for days at a time.

- Strong computer skills. You pick up new software fast. We do not teach computer basics.

- The ability to learn quickly and work on your own.



WHAT PUTS YOU AT THE TOP

- Cold calling experience in US logistics or freight puts you at the top of the list.

- Logistics cold calling experience PLUS experience with cold calling software (dialers, CRMs, call coaching tools) and you're basically hired.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.

1. Start your message with the words "READY TO DIAL" so we know you read the whole post.

2. Attach a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of you speaking English, introducing yourself the way you would on a call.

3. Include a brief summary of your last 3 jobs: company type, your role, how long, and what you did.



IMPORTANT: Your recording must sound like you. The accent we hear on your interview call has to match your recording. If it doesn't, the interview ends right there.



We move fast and don't want to waste anyone's time. If you have these traits, apply today.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Sales Specialist (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **highly skilled Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer** to join our team long-term.



This is **not primarily a cold-calling position**. Our marketing and lead-generation team identifies homeowners who have expressed interest in selling and pre-qualifies them before handing qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Specialist.



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with motivated homeowners, understand their situation, build trust, negotiate pricing and terms, follow up consistently, and ultimately **get profitable real estate contracts signed**.



We currently generate seller opportunities through multiple channels, including **iSpeedToLead, DataSift, SMS marketing, Smarter Contact, Kixie, and our CRM**. Our goal is to build a highly systemized acquisition department where qualified seller opportunities are contacted quickly and no valuable lead falls through the cracks.



Our primary transaction strategy is **novation**, followed by wholesale/assignment when appropriate. We selectively purchase properties ourselves when the profit opportunity is exceptional.



You will work closely with our current Acquisition Manager, operations team, lead-generation team, and company owner. Initially, you will learn our existing acquisition process and work alongside our current Acquisition Manager. The goal is for you to eventually become capable of **independently managing and closing qualified seller opportunities from beginning to end**.



### Responsibilities & Expectations



- Call qualified homeowners who have indicated an interest in selling.

- Respond quickly to newly qualified seller opportunities.

- Build rapport and uncover the seller's true motivation, timeline, condition, financial situation, and desired outcome.

- Negotiate purchase prices and transaction structures professionally and confidently.

- Explain cash offers, novation transactions, and other selling solutions clearly to homeowners.

- Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately.

- Work leads through the CRM until they sell, contract with us, or are otherwise no longer viable.

- Use **Kixie** for outbound calling and follow-up.

- Maintain detailed CRM notes so another team member can immediately understand each seller's situation.

- Work closely with the lead-qualification team to improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisitions.

- Bring complicated or unusually valuable opportunities to management for deal review.

- Participate in call reviews, coaching, and ongoing sales training.

- Become capable of covering for the Acquisition Manager when he is unavailable.

- Ultimately produce approximately **4–6 signed contracts per month** once fully trained and supplied with adequate qualified lead volume.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is **comfortable talking about money, asking difficult questions, negotiating, handling objections, and asking homeowners to make decisions**.



The ideal candidate has prior experience in **U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, investor sales, high-ticket telephone sales, or another negotiation-heavy sales position**.



Excellent spoken English is extremely important. You should sound natural, confident, professional, empathetic, and trustworthy when speaking with U.S. homeowners.



You should also be:



- Highly dependable and available during agreed U.S. business hours.

- Competitive but ethical.

- Persistent without being aggressive.

- Comfortable receiving coaching and having calls reviewed.

- Organized with strong CRM discipline.

- Able to follow a sales process while still thinking independently.

- Comfortable making numerous follow-up calls every day.

- Able to recognize seller motivation and negotiate creatively.

- Comfortable discussing property values, mortgages, equity, repairs, and seller expectations.

- Motivated by measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



## What This Job Is NOT



This is not a position where success is measured by simply making a large number of calls.



We care about:



**Qualified seller conversations → signed contracts → closed transactions → gross profit.**



Our lead-generation team will do much of the initial prospecting and qualification. Your job is to take valuable seller opportunities and **convert them into contracts**.



## Training & Growth



You will initially work closely with our existing Acquisition Manager and review real seller conversations, successful deals, objection handling, negotiation strategies, and our novation process.



We are building redundancy into our acquisition department, so our objective is to have **multiple Acquisition Specialists capable of independently closing deals at a high level**.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on significantly more responsibility as the company grows.



## Schedule



**Full-time position.**



You must be able to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours and be available when homeowners are most likely to answer their phones.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## Compensation



**Competitive base compensation plus performance incentives/bonuses based on results.**



Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skill.



Top performers should have the opportunity to earn substantially more as their contract production increases.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short explanation of your previous sales, real estate, acquisitions, or negotiation experience.

2. Your experience speaking with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your experience using CRMs and telephone dialing systems.

4. Your experience with real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, novations, or motivated sellers, if applicable.

5. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful negotiating with U.S. homeowners.

6. Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

7. Your internet speed and backup internet/power setup.

8. Put the words **“Acquisition Closer”** in the subject line of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



**VOICE RECORDING MANDATORY**. Since this person's job is almost entirely seller communication,

title: Call Center Director – Sales Performance & Team Leadership
description:
We are a large moving and junk removal company based on Long Island, NY, USA. We have built a customer service, sales & marketing company that happens to do junk removal and moving — we've been featured 5 times on the INC 5000 list of Fastest Growing Companies in America and honored as one of Newsday's Top Workplaces. We have worked with remote teams all over the world since 2009 and understand how to build long-term working relationships.



We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Call Center Director to lead our sales and customer service team. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who knows how to build high-performing sales teams, coach agents to improve conversion rates, use data to make smart staffing decisions, and hold people accountable for results.



Our call center handles inbound sales inquiries, outbound customer follow-up, appointment scheduling, and customer service. We need someone who understands that great call center performance comes from effective coaching, smart scheduling, clear expectations, and consistent execution.



Our philosophy is that, in a digital and AI age, people will continue to yearn for human connection. We believe strongly in our human call center agents and their ability to connect - but in order to do that, they must be excellent. I'll admit, I've heard some pretty amazing AI agentic phone calls - but they are only great until they are inconvenient. So we want to embrace technology, use it to make us as efficient as possible, and enable our humans to become super stars.



Responsibilities:

*Sales Performance & Coaching

...lead, coach, and develop agents to improve booking rates, conversion, revenue, and customer experience

...regularly review calls, provide actionable feedback, and improve sales techniques, scripts, and objection handling



*Workforce Management

...analyze call volume, lead patterns, and agent productivity to optimize scheduling, ensure proper coverage, and control labor costs

...monitor attendance, call activity, and service levels



*Recruiting & Team Development

...recruit, interview, hire, train, and manage sales agents

...establish performance expectations, address underperformance, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement



*Reporting & Analytics

...track KPIs including conversion rates, missed calls, agent productivity, and labor efficiency

...identify trends, diagnose problems, and turn data into measurable improvements



*Systems & Process Improvement

...improve sales workflows, customer follow-up, training, and technology

...collaborate with U.S. management and other departments to maximize opportunities and improve results





We will teach you our business and internal systems, but here's what we need from you to succeed in this position:

*Call Center Leadership & Sales Experience

...proven experience leading a sales-focused call center, preferably with inbound and outbound sales

...demonstrated success improving conversion rates, agent performance, and team productivity

...strong ability to coach sales techniques, evaluate recorded calls, and hold agents accountable

...experience recruiting, training, and managing remote sales teams

...experience supporting U.S.-based businesses and customers preferred



*Analytical & Technical Skills

...strong understanding of call center KPIs, workforce management, and performance reporting

...ability to analyze call volume and productivity data to make effective staffing decisions

...proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, and call center platforms

...comfortable identifying problems, implementing solutions, and learning new technology

...experience using AI and automation to improve performance is a significant plus



*Communication, Leadership & Reliability

...excellent spoken and written English

...confident, proactive leader who balances coaching and encouragement with accountability

...highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable making independent decisions

...reliable attendance, high-speed internet, backup connectivity, and a professional home workspace

...available to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours, including some weekend coverage





What Success Looks Like:

We aren't looking for someone who simply keeps the call center running. We want a leader who improves it. You'll be measured by your ability to increase sales conversions, develop stronger agents, optimize staffing, build an effective team, and consistently identify opportunities to improve performance.





Schedule:

This is a full-time position aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Our call center operates seven days per week, and this position requires flexibility to support peak demand periods, including some weekends. The specific schedule will be established based on a combination of your preferred working hours and business needs.



You will work closely with our New York-based leadership team and other remote, Philippines-based team members.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with our company and become an important contributing member of our leadership team.





Compensation:

*Competitive monthly salary based on experience and demonstrated leadership ability (₱100K-120K PHP monthly salary, depending on experience)

*Performance-based bonus opportunities tied to measurable call center results

*13th Month Pay

*Paid national Regular Holidays (10 days) and national Special Holidays (8 days)

*Paid Vacation Days (7 days per year)

*Health Insurance Contributions after 60 Days of ₱3,000

*Annual Anniversary "14th Month" Pay





How to Apply:

We are looking for an experienced leader, not someone looking to learn call center management for the first time.



Please respond here and include:

*A specific example of how you improved sales conversion rates or agent performance, including measurable results

title: Marketing Lead / Growth Strategist for Contractor-Focused AI & Business Platform
description:
Company: Alliance for Contractors

Position Type: Full-Time / Long-Term

Work Hours: Flexible, with overlap for U.S. business hours

Location: Remote

Compensation: Based on experience and skill level



About Alliance for Contractors



Alliance for Contractors is building a modern digital ecosystem for contractors, tradespeople, and construction business owners. We help contractors start, grow, organize, automate, and scale their businesses through AI tools, automation systems, forms, marketing support, operational resources, and business growth strategies.



We are not looking for someone to simply “post on social media.”



We are looking for a marketing-minded operator who can help take Alliance for Contractors to the next level — someone who thinks like a top-tier marketing agency, understands brand positioning, can build campaigns, and knows how to use modern tools like GoHighLevel and AI to move fast.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for a Marketing Lead / Growth Strategist with strong execution skills and a creative mind.



The right person will understand how to create marketing systems that generate attention, build trust, nurture leads, and convert prospects into members, clients, or partners.



You should be able to think strategically, but also execute. We need someone who can help create campaigns, improve funnels, build automations, write content, manage assets, and bring fresh marketing ideas to the company.



Responsibilities



Your role may include:



Creating marketing campaigns for Alliance for Contractors



Building and improving funnels inside GoHighLevel



Writing or assisting with email campaigns, SMS campaigns, landing pages, and nurture sequences



Using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI, automation tools, and other platforms to speed up content and campaign creation



Helping create social media content ideas, captions, hooks, graphics, and posting strategies



Improving lead generation systems



Creating marketing calendars and campaign plans



Helping organize offers, promotions, membership messaging, and contractor-focused campaigns



Researching competitors and market opportunities



Helping turn company ideas into clear campaigns and execution plans



Working with leadership to improve brand positioning and messaging



Creating workflows and automations for follow-up, lead nurturing, and customer engagement



Tracking what is working and suggesting improvements



Required Skills



You should have experience with:



GoHighLevel — funnels, workflows, email/SMS campaigns, forms, landing pages, pipelines, automations, or CRM management



AI tools for marketing, content creation, automation, and research



Digital marketing strategy



Copywriting for ads, emails, landing pages, and social posts



Lead generation and funnel thinking



Campaign planning



Social media marketing



Basic design sense using Canva or similar tools



Organizing projects and following through without needing constant supervision



Nice to Have



Experience marketing to contractors, construction companies, service businesses, home improvement companies, or local businesses



Experience with
 Ads, Google Ads, SEO, or organic content strategy

Experience building membership communities or SaaS-style marketing funnels

Experience with Zapier, Make, Notion, Slack, Google Drive, or project management tools

Experience creating marketing SOPs or campaign templates

The Mindset We Want

We want someone who thinks like a marketing lead, not a task-taker.

You should be able to look at the business and ask:

“How can we get more attention?”

“How can we make this offer clearer?”

“How can we turn this into a campaign?”

“How can we automate this?”

“How can we make contractors trust us faster?”

“How can we improve conversions?”

“How can AI help us move 10x faster?”

We want someone proactive, creative, organized, and hungry to grow with the company.



Why This Role Matters



Alliance for Contractors is building something much bigger than a basic service company. We are creating a platform, a brand, and a movement for contractors.



The person in this role will help shape how the company is seen, how our message reaches contractors, and how our marketing systems grow over time.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to become a key part of a growing company.



How to Apply



Please apply with the subject line:



Marketing Lead – Alliance Growth



In your application, please answer the following:



What is your experience with GoHighLevel?

What AI tools do you use for marketing, content, or automation?

Tell us about a marketing campaign, funnel, or system you helped create.

How would you help Alliance for Contractors attract more contractors?

Share examples of your work, if available.



Applications that do not answer these questions may not be reviewed.



Ideal Candidate Summary



The ideal person is a creative marketing strategist, GoHighLevel builder, AI-powered executor, and growth-minded tea
mber who can help Alliance for Contractors build strong campaigns, better funnels, and a powerful brand presence in the contractor industry.

title: Outbound Call Center Representative
description:
We are searching for motivated, professional individuals to join our team as Call Center Representatives / Appointment Setters. Our representatives connect with homeowners by phone, engage them in conversation, identify potential interest, and schedule qualified appointments for our sales team.



We are looking for individuals who are confident communicators, dependable, coachable, and motivated by performance. You should be comfortable speaking with new people, able to follow a proven process, and willing to continually improve your skills.



We take training seriously and have built a strong, supportive team environment where representatives receive ongoing coaching and development. This is an opportunity to develop valuable sales and communication skills while building a career with significant room for advancement.



Successful representatives can advance into closing positions, team leadership, training, management, and other opportunities within the company. We prefer to develop and promote talented people from within.



Call Center Representative Responsibilities:



Making outbound calls to homeowners and engaging them in conversation.

Following company scripts, processes, and training.

Asking qualifying questions and identifying potential customer interest.

Scheduling qualified appointments for our sales team.

Communicating professionally and confidently with homeowners.

Learning to effectively handle questions and objections.

Accurately entering customer and appointment information into our CRM.

Utilizing dialing software, CRM systems, scripts, and other tools appropriately.

Working toward individual and team performance goals.

Participating in ongoing training, coaching, and development.

Maintaining consistent attendance, reliability, and professionalism.

Adhering to all company policies and procedures.



Call Center Representative Requirements:

Exceptional spoken English is a strict requirement for this position.

We are seeking candidates with clear, fluent, natural-sounding American English and excellent pronunciation.



* Neutral or minimal accent strongly preferred.

* Must be easily understood by American customers without repetition or clarification.

* Excellent English pronunciation, grammar, and conversational skills.

* Ability to communicate confidently, naturally, and professionally with U.S. homeowners.

* Strong listening skills and the ability to maintain smooth, unscripted conversations.



Applicants must pass a live English-speaking assessment before being considered for employment.



Ability to follow a script while maintaining a natural conversation.

Positive attitude and ability to remain motivated throughout the day.

Coachable and willing to learn and improve.

Self-motivated and performance-driven.

Strong work ethic, reliability, and accountability.

Basic computer skills and ability to learn CRM and dialing software.

Previous call center, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or sales experience is preferred but not required.



Mandatory Audio Recording



All applicants MUST submit an English-speaking audio recording with their application.



The recording will be used to evaluate English fluency, pronunciation, clarity, and overall communication skills.



Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.



**Can you please make an audio recording using the following script. Please upload and send via Google Drive. 



Hi, (Eric)? 



Hi (Eric), my name is (Agent Name). I’m calling with Green Energy Solutions, and (Eric), we’re helping homeowners reduce their power bill by 20–40% each month by switching you from your electricity provider over to Green Energy Solutions, and there’s ZERO cost to switch. 



So (Eric), this week we are doing assessments in your area, and we’ll be able to see if your home qualifies to make the switch and give you an apples-to-apples comparison on how much we can lower your bill. 



Now, the assessment only takes half an hour, and it is, of course, free and no obligation. 



(Eric), what would be the best time for us to stop by and show you the savings? 



Are you a morning, afternoon, or evening person?

title: Head of Accounting Team (PTO, 13th Month)
description:
Director of Client Accounting Services

Location: Remote, any country

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.



Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.



Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

$6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

Run your own day outside the core hours.

A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

By month 9: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.

Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
/dcas-application. There is one seat.

description:
Full time. $2,500 to $4,000 USD a month, set by seniority and experience.



At most firms, a franchise client is one more file in a pile of dentists and contractors. At Monterra, franchise clients are the whole job. If you already know how a restaurant group closes its books, with food cost by store, royalty drafts every period and a calendar that never matches the month, this is a place where that knowledge is the point, not a footnote on your resume.



Why people take this job



• One specialty, done well. We serve franchise owners, and most of them run food-service groups with several locations. You get good at one kind of book instead of starting from scratch with every client.

• A reviewer in your corner. A senior accountant reviews every close you finish and sends the report to the client. You get real feedback on your work, and your day goes to the accounting instead of the inbox.

• AI on live work, early. We are rolling AI tools out across the firm. You will use them on real closes, find where they go wrong and help shape how we use them.

• A firm that keeps its clients. Monterra has served business owners since 1991. Not one client has left us in the past year, and new clients sign with us every month.

• A hiring process that respects you. You are judged on a work sample you complete, not on keywords in your resume, and every applicant gets a reply.



What you will do



• Close the books every period for your set of franchise clients

• Reconcile every bank, card and merchant account

• Track inventory and food cost by location, and find out why when a number moves

• Book royalty and advertising fund fees

• Hand your reviewer a clean close, on time



What you need



Franchise client experience. This is the one requirement. You have done accounting work for businesses that pay royalties to a franchisor under a franchise agreement. A multi-location business without a franchise agreement does not count, and we make no exceptions.

You also need to be ready on day one. You know how a close works, and you can run one without anybody walking you through it.



Nice to have: 

13-period accounting, Thomson Reuters Accounting CS, multi-entity books, and hands-on use of AI tools in accounting work.

Not required: a degree, a licence, a particular title, a minimum number of years, or management experience.



Who fits here



You do not leave a reconciliation with a difference in it. When a close runs late, you stay and finish it, because the client is counting on it. You would rather be very good at franchise accounting than average at everything. You do not plug holes just to ship the numbers.



How hiring works



1. Application. About 15 minutes, in your own words. No cover letter.

2. Work sample. A period-end close for a made-up franchisee with three locations. About 90 minutes of work, with 72 hours to finish it. Every candidate gets different numbers.

3. Interview with the owner, about your work sample and your application.

4. References, only after a conditional yes, and only after we tell you.



You may use AI on your application and work sample if you tell us where and how, and you can explain every answer yourself. We check every application for AI use. If you use it and say you did not, your application ends. We also ask your references about the work you describe, so describe it accurately.



Apply at 
. It takes about 15 minutes. Do not apply through OLJ, only applications at that link will be considered.

title: Director of Client Accounting Services
description:
Pay: $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



• Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.

• Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

• We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.

• Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

• The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

• Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

• One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

• Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

• Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

• The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

• A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

• Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

• A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

• A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

• An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

• English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

• Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

• Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

• Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

• $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

• Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

• Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

• Run your own day outside the core hours.

• A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

• Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

• Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

• First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

• By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

• By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

• By month 12: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

1. Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

2. Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

3. Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

4. Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.



Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
. There is one seat.

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online | Multiple US Businesses
description:
We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper who can take ownership of the books for multiple US companies across food service, retail, manufacturing, ecommerce, and technology.



This is a long-term, full-time position. You should be comfortable reviewing messy books, identifying what needs attention, and following through without waiting for someone to assign every next step.



We will provide business context, access, and supporting records. You must bring practical bookkeeping experience and an established workflow.



Schedule



40 working hours per week, Monday through Friday.



10:00 AM–7:00 PM US Eastern Time, including a one-hour unpaid break.



You must follow US daylight saving time changes.



You must be available and responsive during working hours, with no overlapping work commitments.



Immediate availability is preferred.



What You Will Handle



Maintain accurate books for multiple companies in QuickBooks Online.



Review existing records and complete cleanup and catch-up work.



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors.



Categorize transactions using appropriate supporting documents.



Create customer invoices, apply payments, review AR aging, and follow up on overdue balances.



Enter vendor bills, monitor due dates, and prepare payments for approval.



Create purchase orders and match them with vendor bills where applicable.



Review intercompany transactions, owner contributions, loans, and clearing accounts.



Complete month-end reviews and prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.



Maintain clear records of missing documents, unresolved discrepancies, deadlines, and progress.



What We Expect



Independent ownership: Know what needs to happen next and maintain your own work plan across companies.



Clear communication: Explain discrepancies, corrections, and blockers in plain language.



Consistent responsiveness: Acknowledge instructions and respond to work messages during your shift.



Visible progress: Send start-of-shift priorities and an end-of-day report covering completed work, pending items, blockers, and expected completion dates.



Sound judgment: Investigate discrepancies, document corrections, and seek clarification when needed.



Confidentiality: Handle financial records and access responsibly.



Required Qualifications



At least three years of hands-on bookkeeping experience.



At least two years of actual QuickBooks Online client work, including US businesses.



Experience managing several companies’ books simultaneously.



Practical experience with reconciliations, cleanup, AP, AR, and monthly reporting.



Confidence using Google Sheets or Excel to organize and review financial information.



Two professional references who have directly supervised or reviewed your bookkeeping work.



Certifications are welcome, but you must be able to demonstrate your skills and explain your own work.



How to Apply



Use this exact subject line:



BALANCED - Your Full Name



Answer each question using the numbering below. Keep your answers specific and based on work you personally performed.



Résumé: Share a viewable link to your updated résumé.



Actual Experience: State your years of bookkeeping experience, actual QuickBooks Online experience, and experience supporting US businesses. Separate client work from training.



Multiple Companies: What is the highest number of companies you handled simultaneously? Include their industries and the responsibilities you personally owned.



Your Workflow: Explain how you track reconciliations, missing documents, deadlines, and outstanding work across companies.



Specific Cleanup Example: Describe one actual discrepancy you resolved. What caused it, what correction did you make, and how did you verify the result?



Accounts Receivable: Describe your experience with invoicing, applying payments, aging reports, and overdue collections.



Independent Prioritization: You have finished today’s transaction categorization, but the owner is unavailable. How would you d
 what to work on next?



Expected Compensation: State your expected fixed monthly rate in USD for 40 working hours per week.



Availability: Confirm the required Eastern Time schedule, including daylight saving changes. List your current work commitments and earliest start date.



Certifications and References: List relevant certifications and confirm whether you can provide two professional references who supervised or reviewed your bookkeeping.



Hiring Process



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short bookkeeping assessment. Candidates who pass will be invited to an initial interview, including a brief live walkthrough of their answers and approach.



Please complete application answers and assessments independently. We want to understand your own experience, reasoning, and communication.



Applications with missing answers or an incorrect subject line will not move forward.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels, Shorts, and Social Content (30–180 sec)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We are a real estate company that produces long-form video content across education, investment, faith and land development topics. We need a short-form editor who can take that long-form content and clip it into high-performing short-form videos for Reels, Shorts, and social platforms. Occasionally you will also create variations of existing short-form clips for use as ads.

 

This is a high-volume, ongoing role. If your edits perform, there's consistent work and performance bonuses on top of your per-video rate.

 

---

 

SCOPE

 

Short-form videos between 30 and 180 seconds, repurposed from long-form source content. Up to 25 videos per week, capped at 100 per month. Each video must be fully platform-ready on delivery — no open loops.

 

Primary: Clipping and editing short-form content from long-form recordings

Secondary: Creating ad variations from existing short-form clips

 

---

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN EVERY EDIT

 

- Hook mastery — you can identify the strongest moments in a long-form video and know how to open with a visual hook, text hook, and audio hook that stops the scroll in the first 2–3 seconds

- Body retention — the middle holds attention as well as the opening; pacing, pattern interrupts, and visual momentum throughout

- Smooth call to action — the CTA feels like a natural close, not a hard sell bolted on at the end

- Effective audio — music and sound design that reinforces the message and energy without overpowering it; aligned with brand, not exaggerated

- Brand alignment — every clip should feel like it belongs to the same family of content; consistent tone, text style, and visual rhythm

- Platform awareness — you know what works on Reels vs. Shorts and can optimize accordingly without being told

 

---

 

SKILLS REQUIRED

 

- Strong short-form portfolio — share examples that show you can pull compelling clips from long-form source material

- Proven understanding of what makes short-form content perform, not just look good

- Experience creating ad variations from organic short-form content

- Captions, text overlays, and on-screen graphics that complement — not clutter — the video

- Comfortable working at volume with fast turnaround

- Familiar with 
 for review and approval, and Google Drive for final file delivery

 

---

 

WORKFLOW

 

You'll receive long-form source footage and a brief for each batch. Edits are submitted to 
 for review and approval. Once approved, final files are uploaded to a designated Google Drive folder per the instructions provided.

 

---

 

COMPENSATION

 

- Rate: $15 per approved video

- Max volume: 100 videos/month (~25/week)

- Monthly cap: $1,500/month

- Performance bonuses: available for videos that hit strong view, reach, and engagement benchmarks

 

Pay is strictly per approved and delivered video. Only videos that clear the 
 approval process count toward your monthly total. There is no guaranteed floor — you are paid for what you deliver.

 

Videos that consistently perform well are eligible for bonuses. We track what works and reward the edits that drive results. Strong, consistent output over time opens the door to increased volume and rate.

 

---

 

TO APPLY — ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS IN YOUR PROPOSAL

 

1. Walk me through how you identify the best clips inside a long-form video. What are you looking for, and how do you d
 where to start and end a clip?

 

2. Share 2–3 short-form videos you edited that were repurposed from long-form content — and tell us what you were trying to accomplish with each one beyond just making it look good.

 

3. How do you use audio in a short-form video? What's your approach to music selection and sound design for a professional brand that wants energy without feeling overhyped?

title: Admin/Executive Assistant
description:
To apply, please fill out this form: 



Work Setup: 100% Remote / Work From Home

Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM EST (U.S. Eastern Time)

Employment Type: Part-Time



About the Company

We are a U.S.-based commercial drywall contracting company specializing in commercial construction and interior build-out projects, including retail stores, restaurants, offices, and other commercial spaces.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Administrative Assistant / Executive Assistant to support our company president and assist with the company's daily business operations.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates confidently, takes initiative, and can efficiently manage multiple administrative tasks while ensuring that day-to-day operations run smoothly.



This position will involve both business-related administrative responsibilities and assisting the president with personal and other tasks as needed. We are looking for someone flexible, resourceful, trustworthy, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

1. Employee Timekeeping & Coordination

- Communicate with field employees daily regarding their timesheets.

- Follow up with employees to ensure timesheets are submitted accurately and on time.

- Review submitted timesheets for completeness and verify that all required information is provided.

2. Supplier & Material Coordination

- Assist with general administrative tasks and daily operational support.

4. Scheduling & Calendar Management

- Manage calendars, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings.

- Track important deadlines, follow-ups, and scheduled activities.

- Provide reminders and ensure scheduled tasks are completed on time.

5. Executive & Personal Assistance

- Provide direct administrative and organizational support to the company president.

- Assist the president with personal and business-related administrative tasks, scheduling, appointments, research, and other requests as needed.

- Help coordinate personal matters, appointments, reservations, and other arrangements when requested.

- Handle confidential information and sensitive matters with professionalism and discretion.

- Assist with special assignments, follow-ups, and other tasks delegated by the president.

6. Other Duties & General Support

- Perform other administrative, operational, and organizational tasks as assigned by the company president or management.

- Provide general support wherever needed to help the company and its management operate efficiently.



Qualifications & Requirements

- At least 5 years of experience working as a Virtual Assistant or Remote Administrative Assistant is REQUIRED.

- Previous experience working with a construction company, contractor, or related industry is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Confident and professional when communicating through phone calls,
s, and messaging platforms.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Strong sense of responsibility, reliability, and work ethic.

- Proactive problem-solver who can work independently with minimal supervision.

- Ability to work efficiently under pressure, meet deadlines, and prioritize tasks.

- Flexible and adaptable, with a willingness to handle different types of assignments and responsibilities.

- Trustworthy and able to handle confidential business and personal information with discretion.

- Strong computer skills and proficiency in:

o Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

o Cloud-based file management platforms such as SharePoint and Dropbox

o Comfortable learning and navigating company-specific software, systems, and applications.



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not just an assistant but a reliable and trustworthy team member who can take ownership of assigned responsibilities.



The right candidate should be someone who:

- Takes initiative instead of waiting for constant instructions.

- Follows through on tasks and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

- Communicates clearly, confidently, and consistently.

- Pays close attention to details and values accuracy.

- Can be trusted to handle both business-related and personal administrative matters.

- Is resourceful and capable of finding solutions rather than waiting for someone else to resolve every issue.

- Can adapt to changing priorities and manage different responsibilities throughout the day.

- Maintains professionalism, confidentiality, and a strong sense of accountability.

title: Local SEO VA: Business Listings, Citations and Profile Building (Auto Shops, USA)
description:
We are a US marketing team that runs local SEO for 50+ auto detailing, window tint, and paint protection shops across the United States.



We need a careful, detail-loving VA to build and fix our clients’ business listings and profiles online: directories (Yelp, Manta, Hotfrog, and similar), data aggregators, map listings, and profile pages on platforms like GitHub, Issuu, DeviantArt, and link-in-bio sites.



This is not a “blast 500 links” job. Every listing must show the same business name, address, phone number, and description, word for word. One typo in a phone number is a failed task. If you are the person who double-checks everything, this job is for you.



What you will do each day:



Work from a client sheet: search first to see if a listing already exists, then create or claim it.

Paste the client’s approved name, address, phone, hours, description, logo, and photos exactly as given.

Confirm
 links and save every login in our shared password manager.

Log the live profile URL and a screenshot in the tracking sheet.

Report anything that needs the shop owner (phone or postcard verification) instead of guessing.



Must have:



1+ year building citations, directory listings, or Web 2.0 profiles for US businesses (show us live examples).

Strong written English and very high accuracy.

Comfortable with Google Sheets, a password manager, and screenshots.

Stable internet and your own computer.

Honest reporting: you say “I could not do this” instead of guessing.



Nice to have:



Experience with BrightLocal, Whitespark, or Moz Local.

Experience with Apple Business Connect, Bing Places, Yelp for Business.

Basic understanding of what NAP consistency means and why it matters.



How to apply:



Start your application with the words “Same NAP every time”.

Send 3 live listing or profile URLs you built yourself, and say what the business was.

In 3 to 5 sentences: what do you do when a directory already has a listing for the business with an old phone number?

Your hours available and your monthly rate.

title: Personal Financial Assistant
description:
I earn well and spend across many accounts, but I do not have the time to watch my money every day. I need one dependable person who looks at my accounts every day, keeps every expense sorted into the right category, and tells me early when I am getting close to my limit in any category. The goal is simple: I should never be surprised by where my money went, and the money for the things that matter most to me (savings, investing, family) should always get set aside first.

You will not be making financial decisions for me. You will be my early warning system and my organizer. You watch, sort, flag, and report. I d
.



What you will do every day

• Log in to my accounts (bank accounts, credit cards, and the budgeting app we set up) and review every new transaction from the past 24 hours.

• Put each transaction in the correct spending category (for example: groceries, dining out, childcare, travel, shopping, subscriptions, home, car).

• Compare spending in each category to its monthly budget.

• Send me one short daily message (text or
, my choice) with:

    ◦ Total spent yesterday

    ◦ Any category that crossed a warning level (see the alert rules below)

    ◦ Anything that looks wrong or unusual



• Flag right away (do not wait for the daily message):

    ◦ Any charge you do not recognize or that looks like fraud

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Operations Coordinator — Part-Time | $4/hour + Bonus



The Black Therapy Network (BTN) helps people connect with culturally responsive mental health care. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates warmly, solves problems, and follows through without constant reminders.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Help people who started signing up complete enrollment.

• Support clients with account and scheduling issues.

• Coordinate therapist onboarding and missing documents.

• Manage communications and keep 
 and BTN records organized.

• Give every open issue a clear next action and follow-up date.

• Check previous communications before contacting anyone.



Healthcare coordination, customer service, and 
 experience are preferred. You must communicate clearly in English, work independently, and have reliable internet, a headset, and backup arrangements.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

• $4 USD/hour, part-time, during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours.

• $3 per qualifying recovered client, capped at $25 per month.

• A qualifying recovery is an assigned unpaid signup you personally help convert who completes their first paid session. Results must be documented and verified; each client counts once. Pending refunds or disputes must be resolved before qualification. Scheduling delays preserve pending recovery credit.



HOW TO APPLY — SUBMIT EVERYTHING TOGETHER



Begin your application with “BTN Assessment — [Your Full Name]”. Include all four sections below in one application. Allow approximately 45 minutes. Use fictional information only; do not access live BTN systems or purchase software.



1. YOUR FIT AND AVAILABILITY



Answer these questions:

1. Do you accept the pay and bonus structure?

2. What exact days and hours can you work in U.S. Eastern Time? Include desired weekly hours and earliest start date.

3. What other work commitments do you have? Do any hours overlap?

4. What computer, headset, internet, and backup arrangements will you use?

5. Describe one process you personally managed from first contact through resolution. How did you prevent missed follow-ups?



Include your résumé or résumé link.



2. PRACTICAL ASSESSMENT



Imagine your shift is Monday, 10 a.m.–1 p.m. Eastern.



Rules:

• Management approves refunds, therapist activation, and exceptions.

• Matching requires verified authorization for the client’s state, appropriate services, and compatible availability.

• An opened
 is not a reply or proof of completion.

• Do not invent missing facts or describe proposed actions as completed.



Review these six fictional cases:



A — Login problem: A client has a confirmed appointment at 10:30 a.m. today but cannot log in.



B — Paid-client complaint: A client says they paid five days ago, have no confirmed therapist, and
ed twice. They write: “Nobody helped me. I want my money back.” Payment, refund, and dispute status have not been verified.



C — Matching problem: A Florida client needs individual therapy after 6 p.m. Eastern. Therapist One is verified for Florida but has only morning availability. Therapist Two offers evenings but is verified for Georgia only.



D — Conflicting records: Monday shows a therapist as Active, but their agreement is missing one required signature and payment setup is pending. No approved exception is documented. The therapist says, “I finished everything.”



E — Unfinished signup: A person writes: “I started signing up, but $89 feels expensive, and I’m not sure therapy will help.” Their state and therapist availability are unverified. For this exercise only, management permits a $69 introductory offer after a suitable opening is confirmed. Ongoing pricing has not been supplied.



F — Duplicate outreach: A signup received a follow-up yesterday and replied this morning. Another staff member scheduled the same reminder for today. You have not read the reply yet.



Create one spreadsheet with two tabs:



Tab 1: Tracker



Include six rows, A–F, using these exact columns:



Case ID | Priority rank | Verified facts | Information to check | Next action | Responsible person | Follow-up deadline in Eastern Time | Approval or escalation needed | Evidence needed to close



Use each priority rank 1–6 once, with 1 highest. Give specific Monday follow-up times—not “ASAP.”



Tab 2: Responses



Include five numbered answers:

1. Explain your priority order—maximum 150 words.

2. Write your reply to client B—maximum 120 words.

3. Write your reply to prospect E—maximum 120 words. Show warmth, explain value, explore the concern, and suggest a next step without pressure or unsupported promises.

4. Write an internal note about therapist D—maximum 100 words.

5. Explain your immediate action for F and how you would prevent duplicate follow-ups.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Submit one 3–4 minute recording, using your own voice and normal work headset. Video is not required. We assess clarity, warmth, judgment, and audio quality—not a particular accent.



Start by reading this exactly, replacing the name placeholder:



“Hi, this is [your first name] with the Black Therapy Network. Is now a good time to speak privately? I’m sorry you’ve had to reach out more than once. I want to understand what happened, check the details, and help you with the next step.”



Then respond naturally to each statement as if speaking to a client:

• “I already paid. Nobody called me back. Why should I trust you?”

• “Eighty-nine dollars is too much, and I’m not sure therapy is for me.”

• “I’m in Florida and need an evening appointment. Can you guarantee someone for tomorrow?”



Use only the assessment facts. Do not guarantee an unconfirmed appointment, refund, or treatment outcome.



4. RELIABILITY



Briefly explain what you would do if:

• Your internet failed 15 minutes before your shift.

• You discovered you sent incorrect onboarding instructions.

• Your shift was ending with an urgent client issue unresolved.



For each, explain your immediate action, whom you would notify, and how you would ensure follow-through.



BEFORE SUBMITTING



Include your fit answers, résumé, spreadsheet, recording link, reliability answers, total time spent, and any tools or AI assistance used. Check that all links open without an access request. Use your own reasoning; we may ask you to explain your choices during an interview.



Submit the complete application together. Incomplete applications may not move forward.



The Black Therapy Network

title: Paid Fitness App Tester (Bodyweight Training for Women) - Project-Based, Monthly Feedback
description:

title: Bookkeeper (Quickbooks Online)
description:
Full time l 40 hours per week l EST



MUST HAVE US BUSINESS EXPERIENCE, QUICKBOOKS ONLINE

SEND YOUR RESUME, WHATSAPP NUMBER AND VOCAROO LINK



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. DAILY BOOKKEEPING AND TRANSACTION PROCESSING

• Record, categorize, and maintain daily financial transactions in QuickBooks Online.

• Ensure transactions are properly classified under the appropriate accounts.

• Review financial entries for accuracy and completeness.

• Maintain organized and up-to-date bookkeeping records.

• Identify unusual transactions or inconsistencies and bring them to the appropriate person's attention.

2. BANK AND CREDIT CARD RECONCILIATION

• Perform regular bank account reconciliations.

• Reconcile business credit card transactions and statements.

• Match recorded transactions against bank and credit card statements.

• Identify discrepancies, duplicate entries, missing transactions, and incorrect classifications.

• Investigate reconciliation differences and coordinate their resolution.

• Ensure reconciliation records are accurate and completed within established deadlines.

3. FINANCIAL RECORD MAINTENANCE

• Maintain accurate and organized bookkeeping records.

• Ensure supporting transaction documentation is properly recorded and accessible.

• Review transaction histories and identify potential bookkeeping errors.

• Maintain consistency in financial records and account categorization.

• Assist in keeping bookkeeping records current and ready for review.

4. WORKFLOW MANAGEMENT AND ACCOUNTABILITY

• Complete assigned daily and recurring bookkeeping tasks independently.

• Follow established procedures and meet agreed productivity and accuracy targets.

• Communicate progress and report any issues or discrepancies promptly.

• Take ownership of assigned responsibilities without requiring constant follow-ups.

• Accept constructive feedback and implement necessary corrections.

• Demonstrate flexibility in learning new systems, processes, and technologies.

5. TECHNOLOGY AND AI ADAPTABILITY

• Demonstrate willingness to learn and adopt AI-powered tools that support bookkeeping processes.

• Explore opportunities to improve efficiency through technology and automation.

• Adapt to new software, workflows, and operational procedures.

• Maintain accuracy and proper review when using AI-assisted tools.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Proven experience in bookkeeping or a similar accounting support position.

• Mandatory hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO).

• Good understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles.

• Experience recording and categorizing financial transactions.

• Practical experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations.

• Ability to identify discrepancies and investigate transaction errors.

• Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Strong English communication skills.

title: Cold Caller & Phone Sales Closer (Part-Time, US Hours) - Pest Control / Home Services
description:
ABOUT US

Bee Man Dan LLC is a Houston, Texas company that does bee removal and hive relocation. We locate hives with thermal imaging; we have served Houston-area families since 2015, and we are 5-star Google-rated. Our operations team works remotely from the Philippines.

 

THE ROLE

We need a confident phone salesperson who can call warm leads and turn them into bookings. This is a hands-on calling role: you will follow up with people who've already shown interest, answer their questions honestly, and close. Over time, the role grows into B2B outreach to referral partners.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO (in order of priority)

1. Call back people who signed up for our Buzz for Gold collectible coin promotion and have not purchased yet. Answer their questions clearly and honestly, with no pressure tactics and no promises about results. (about 3 hours a day)

2. Help close hive removal bookings: call back quotes and warm leads, follow our call script, confirm the address and ZIP code, and book the job.

3. Build lead lists of referral partners (pest control companies, property managers, real estate agents, roofers). You research and record them in a tracker. B2B calling starts in the spring.

4. Log every call and outcome in our call tracker and ClickUp, and hand off bookings and open items to the right teammate.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven outbound phone sales or cold calling experience (B2B or B2C), at least 1 year (required)

- Customer service and inbound sales experience, comfortable asking for the sale (required)

- Clear, natural spoken English, comfortable talking with US callers (required)

- Handles rejection well, coachable, follows a script, and stays honest with customers (required)

- US pest control, home services, lead generation, or promotion/sweepstakes callback experience (strongly preferred, not required: we will train you on our process)

- Comfortable researching prospects online (Google Maps, LinkedIn, company websites) and keeping a clean Google Sheet or CRM

- Quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and a backup connection or power

- Dependable, detail-oriented, able to work with little supervision

 

PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

Base pay plus performance incentives for bookings and sales you close. The incentive structure is discussed directly with the selected candidate.

 

SCHEDULE

Part-time, about 3-5 hours a day, Monday to Friday (about 25 hours a week), during Central Time (Houston) daytime hours. That means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring.

 

TERMS

Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. The first 2 weeks are a paid trial with a check-in at the end of week 1 and a decision at the end of week 2.

 

HOW TO APPLY (please follow all steps, incomplete applications are not reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word BEE so we know you read this post.

2. Attach your resume.

3. Write 3 to 4 sentences about your calling experience (industry, calls per day, results, how long).

4. Send a UNIQUE video intro (2 to 3 minutes, Loom or a video file/link), recorded for this application. Camera on, face visible. Start by saying your name and the word BEE. Answer these 3 questions:

   a) Tell us about your outbound or sales calling experience: the industry, your targets, and one result you are proud of (a number if you have one). Describe one call you closed and what you said.

   b) A homeowner says "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next to move toward a booking without pressure? And what do you say to a business owner who tells you "We're not interested"?

   c) Have you worked in pest control, home services, or promotion/sweepstakes follow-up calls? If not, tell us how you would build a list of 50 property managers in Houston.

5. Tell us your available hours for Central Time and your earliest start date.

 

Applications without a unique video intro are not reviewed. Generic or reused intro videos are not accepted.

 

Shortlisted applicants complete a short live phone role-play.

 

=== REQUIRED SKILLS ===

Cold Calling, Outbound Sales, Telemarketing, Inside Sales, Appointment Setting, Lead Generation, B2B Sales, Customer Service, Sales Closing, Pest Control, Home Services, CRM, Google Sheets, ClickUp

What success looks like
